name: create_op44_schema
statements:
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
-- OPERATION 44 SCHEMA
-- Three tables: leads, OBI assessments, page events
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════

-- 1. LEADS: form submissions from Operation 44 landing page
CREATE TABLE public.op44_leads (
  id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  first_name text,
  last_name text,
  email text NOT NULL,
  phone text,
  facility_name text,
  facility_type text,
  role text,
  department text,
  source_page text DEFAULT 'operation-44',
  utm_source text,
  utm_medium text,
  utm_campaign text,
  status text DEFAULT 'new' CHECK (status IN ('new', 'contacted', 'qualified', 'converted', 'disqualified')),
  notes text,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Unique constraint on email to prevent duplicates
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_op44_leads_email ON public.op44_leads (email);

-- 2. OBI ASSESSMENTS: OBI-20 scores and responses
CREATE TABLE public.obi_assessments (
  id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  lead_id bigint REFERENCES public.op44_leads(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  email text NOT NULL,
  facility_name text,
  role text,
  score numeric(5,2),
  tier text CHECK (tier IN ('visible', 'at_risk', 'blind')),
  responses jsonb DEFAULT '{}',
  source_page text DEFAULT 'obi-20',
  session_id text,
  completed boolean DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Index for lookups by email and tier
CREATE INDEX idx_obi_email ON public.obi_assessments (email);
CREATE INDEX idx_obi_tier ON public.obi_assessments (tier);

-- 3. PAGE EVENTS: analytics for views, clicks, conversions
CREATE TABLE public.page_events (
  id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id text NOT NULL,
  event_type text NOT NULL CHECK (event_type IN (
    'page_view', 'scroll_depth', 'cta_click', 'form_start',
    'form_submit', 'obi_start', 'obi_complete', 'video_play',
    'section_view', 'exit_intent'
  )),
  event_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}',
  page text DEFAULT '/',
  referrer text,
  utm_source text,
  utm_medium text,
  utm_campaign text,
  device_type text,
  viewport_width integer,
  time_on_page integer,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Indexes for analytics queries
CREATE INDEX idx_events_session ON public.page_events (session_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_type ON public.page_events (event_type);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_page ON public.page_events (page);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_created ON public.page_events (created_at);

-- Enable RLS on all tables
ALTER TABLE public.op44_leads ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.obi_assessments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.page_events ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- RLS policies: allow anonymous inserts from the frontend
CREATE POLICY "Allow anonymous insert on op44_leads"
  ON public.op44_leads FOR INSERT
  TO anon WITH CHECK (true);

CREATE POLICY "Allow anonymous insert on obi_assessments"
  ON public.obi_assessments FOR INSERT
  TO anon WITH CHECK (true);

CREATE POLICY "Allow anonymous insert on page_events"
  ON public.page_events FOR INSERT
  TO anon WITH CHECK (true);

-- Auto-update timestamp trigger for leads
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = now();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_op44_leads_updated
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.op44_leads
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

-- Underwriting quotes table: stores every generated quote
CREATE TABLE public.underwriting_quotes (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  facility_name text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  technician_ftes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  leader_ftes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  total_ftes integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS (technician_ftes + leader_ftes) STORED,
  facility_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  contract_term text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'month_to_month',
  discount_pct numeric(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  otis_monthly numeric(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  otis_floor_applied boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  stewardship_rate_per_fte numeric(8,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  stewardship_active numeric(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  stewardship_maintenance numeric(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  stewardship_floor_applied boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  total_monthly_active numeric(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  total_monthly_maintenance numeric(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  annual_active numeric(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  gross_margin_monthly numeric(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  gross_margin_pct numeric(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  created_by text,
  notes text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- TCO comparison snapshots
CREATE TABLE public.tco_comparisons (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  quote_id uuid REFERENCES public.underwriting_quotes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  total_ftes integer NOT NULL,
  comparison_years integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
  sips_monthly numeric(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  sips_tco numeric(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Individual competitor line items within a TCO comparison
CREATE TABLE public.tco_competitor_lines (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  comparison_id uuid REFERENCES public.tco_comparisons(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  competitor_name text NOT NULL,
  data_label text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Approx.',
  setup_fee numeric(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  db_build_fee numeric(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  monthly_platform numeric(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  annual_training numeric(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  total_tco numeric(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  savings_vs_sips numeric(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  savings_pct numeric(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  modules_description text,
  is_approximate boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
);

-- Enable RLS on all tables
ALTER TABLE public.underwriting_quotes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.tco_comparisons ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.tco_competitor_lines ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Service role policies (edge functions use service role key)
CREATE POLICY "service_role_full_access" ON public.underwriting_quotes
  FOR ALL USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

CREATE POLICY "service_role_full_access" ON public.tco_comparisons
  FOR ALL USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

CREATE POLICY "service_role_full_access" ON public.tco_competitor_lines
  FOR ALL USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

-- Index for quick lookups
CREATE INDEX idx_quotes_facility ON public.underwriting_quotes(facility_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_quotes_status ON public.underwriting_quotes(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_quotes_created ON public.underwriting_quotes(created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_tco_quote ON public.tco_comparisons(quote_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_tco_lines_comparison ON public.tco_competitor_lines(comparison_id);

name: sbd_core_schema
statements:
-- ============================================================
-- SBD BELT INTELLIGENCE PLATFORM - CORE SCHEMA
-- ============================================================

-- Hospital Systems (multi-facility groups)
CREATE TABLE public.sbd_hospital_systems (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name text NOT NULL,
  contact_name text,
  contact_email text,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Facilities
CREATE TABLE public.sbd_facilities (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  system_id uuid REFERENCES public.sbd_hospital_systems(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  name text NOT NULL,
  location text NOT NULL,
  department text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Sterile Processing',
  contact_name text,
  contact_email text,
  since text,
  active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Portal Users (linked to auth.users for real auth)
CREATE TABLE public.sbd_portal_users (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  auth_uid uuid UNIQUE REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  email text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  password_hash text,
  role text NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('master_admin','staff_admin','system_admin','hospital','staff_member')),
  name text NOT NULL,
  title text,
  initials text,
  facility_id text REFERENCES public.sbd_facilities(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  system_id uuid REFERENCES public.sbd_hospital_systems(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  staff_id integer,
  assigned_facility_ids text[] DEFAULT '{}',
  active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  last_login_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Staff Members
CREATE TABLE public.sbd_staff (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  facility_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sbd_facilities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  first_name text NOT NULL,
  last_name text NOT NULL,
  role text NOT NULL,
  belt text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'White' CHECK (belt IN ('White','Yellow','Green','Blue','Brown','Black')),
  belt_since date NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  stars integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cur_comp text CHECK (cur_comp IS NULL OR cur_comp IN ('pass','fail')),
  cur_sim text CHECK (cur_sim IS NULL OR cur_sim IN ('pass','fail')),
  cur_obs text CHECK (cur_obs IS NULL OR cur_obs IN ('pass','fail')),
  nxt_comp text CHECK (nxt_comp IS NULL OR nxt_comp IN ('pass','fail')),
  nxt_sim text CHECK (nxt_sim IS NULL OR nxt_sim IN ('pass','fail')),
  nxt_obs text CHECK (nxt_obs IS NULL OR nxt_obs IN ('pass','fail')),
  ps_enrolled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ps_done boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ps_track text DEFAULT '',
  ps_module text DEFAULT '',
  promo_recommended boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_sbd_staff_facility ON public.sbd_staff(facility_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_sbd_staff_belt ON public.sbd_staff(belt);

-- Assessment History
CREATE TABLE public.sbd_assessment_history (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  staff_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sbd_staff(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  facility_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sbd_facilities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  assessment_type text NOT NULL CHECK (assessment_type IN ('Competency','Simulation','Observation')),
  target_belt text NOT NULL CHECK (target_belt IN ('White','Yellow','Green','Blue','Brown','Black')),
  result text NOT NULL CHECK (result IN ('pass','fail')),
  notes text,
  assessed_by uuid,
  assessed_at date NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_sbd_assess_history_staff ON public.sbd_assessment_history(staff_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_sbd_assess_history_facility ON public.sbd_assessment_history(facility_id);

-- Assessment Queue (pending assessments)
CREATE TABLE public.sbd_assessment_queue (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  staff_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sbd_staff(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  facility_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sbd_facilities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  assessment_type text NOT NULL CHECK (assessment_type IN ('Competency','Simulation','Observation')),
  target_belt text NOT NULL CHECK (target_belt IN ('White','Yellow','Green','Blue','Brown','Black')),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','pass','fail','cancelled')),
  requested_date date NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  notes text,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_sbd_queue_status ON public.sbd_assessment_queue(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_sbd_queue_facility ON public.sbd_assessment_queue(facility_id);

-- Pending Facility Registrations
CREATE TABLE public.sbd_pending_registrations (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  facility_name text NOT NULL,
  location text NOT NULL,
  department text NOT NULL,
  contact_name text NOT NULL,
  contact_email text NOT NULL,
  password_hash text,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected')),
  reviewed_by uuid,
  reviewed_at timestamptz,
  requested_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Facility Trends (monthly metrics per facility per year)
CREATE TABLE public.sbd_facility_trends (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  facility_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sbd_facilities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  year integer NOT NULL,
  month text NOT NULL,
  month_index integer NOT NULL,
  green_pct numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  avg_belt numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  promotions integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(facility_id, year, month_index)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_sbd_trends_facility_year ON public.sbd_facility_trends(facility_id, year);

-- Report Audit Log
CREATE TABLE public.sbd_report_audit_log (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  facility_id text REFERENCES public.sbd_facilities(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  generated_by uuid,
  report_type text,
  generated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Admin Activity Log
CREATE TABLE public.sbd_activity_log (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid,
  action text NOT NULL,
  target_type text,
  target_id text,
  details jsonb DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_sbd_activity_created ON public.sbd_activity_log(created_at DESC);

-- V23 Migration 6: Create sbd_schedule table
-- Safety: GREEN - brand new table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sbd_schedule (
  id                uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  facility_id       text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sbd_facilities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  date              date NOT NULL,
  shift             text NOT NULL,
  assigned_staff    integer[] DEFAULT '{}',
  published_by      uuid,
  notes             text DEFAULT '',
  zone_assignments  jsonb DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at        timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at        timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.sbd_schedule ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Master admin full access
CREATE POLICY "sbd_schedule_master_all" ON public.sbd_schedule FOR ALL
  USING (sbd_get_user_role() = 'master_admin')
  WITH CHECK (sbd_get_user_role() = 'master_admin');

-- Staff admin manages assigned facilities
CREATE POLICY "sbd_schedule_staff_admin_all" ON public.sbd_schedule FOR ALL
  USING (
    sbd_get_user_role() = 'staff_admin' AND
    facility_id IN (SELECT unnest(sbd_get_assigned_facilities()))
  )
  WITH CHECK (
    sbd_get_user_role() = 'staff_admin' AND
    facility_id IN (SELECT unnest(sbd_get_assigned_facilities()))
  );

-- Hospital reads own facility
CREATE POLICY "sbd_schedule_hospital_select" ON public.sbd_schedule FOR SELECT
  USING (facility_id = sbd_get_user_facility());

-- Staff member reads own facility
CREATE POLICY "sbd_schedule_staff_member_select" ON public.sbd_schedule FOR SELECT
  USING (facility_id = sbd_get_user_facility() AND sbd_get_user_role() = 'staff_member');

-- System admin reads system facilities
CREATE POLICY "sbd_schedule_system_admin_select" ON public.sbd_schedule FOR SELECT
  USING (
    sbd_get_user_role() = 'system_admin' AND
    facility_id IN (SELECT id FROM sbd_facilities WHERE system_id = sbd_get_user_system())
  );

-- Index for common query pattern
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sbd_schedule_facility_date ON public.sbd_schedule(facility_id, date);

fix_user_onboarding_rls
statements:
-- Drop old restrictive policy and replace with one that works for both auth.uid() and portal user IDs
-- The user_onboarding table's user_id stores auth.uid() values, so the fix is in the app code.
-- But we also need to allow sbd_portal_users with matching auth_uid to write.

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Users can manage their own onboarding" ON public.user_onboarding;

-- Policy: authenticated users can read/write rows where user_id = their auth.uid()
CREATE POLICY "Users can manage their own onboarding"
ON public.user_onboarding
FOR ALL
TO authenticated
USING (auth.uid() = user_id)
WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Also allow portal admin roles (master_admin, staff_admin) to read all onboarding records
CREATE POLICY "Admins can read all onboarding"
ON public.user_onboarding
FOR SELECT
TO authenticated
USING (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.sbd_portal_users
    WHERE auth_uid = auth.uid()
    AND role IN ('master_admin', 'staff_admin')
  )
);

-- ============================================
-- SBD ASSESSMENT INTELLIGENCE PLATFORM (AIP)
-- Migration 1: Levels and Scripts Foundation
-- ============================================

-- ENUM types for the platform
CREATE TYPE aip_level_type AS ENUM ('belt', 'position_school');
CREATE TYPE aip_difficulty AS ENUM ('easy', 'medium', 'hard');
CREATE TYPE aip_question_type AS ENUM (
  'short_answer', 'multiple_choice', 'true_false', 'fill_blank',
  'script_recall', 'scenario_multi', 'ucp_execution', 'instrument_id',
  'formula_calc', 'sequence', 'matching', 'flashcard'
);
CREATE TYPE aip_content_category AS ENUM (
  'script_knowledge', 'vocabulary', 'protocol', 'instrument',
  'formula', 'ucp', 'coaching', 'escalation', 'documentation',
  'certification', 'audit', 'rca', 'leadership', 'compliance',
  'system_philosophy', 'vendor', 'safety_event', 'handoff',
  'communication', 'general'
);
CREATE TYPE aip_assessment_mode AS ENUM (
  'practice_quiz', 'timed_test', 'simulation', 'flashcard_session',
  'weak_spot', 'belt_mastery', 'script_drill', 'instrument_challenge'
);
CREATE TYPE aip_question_part AS ENUM ('knowledge', 'scenario', 'instrument');
CREATE TYPE aip_flashcard_status AS ENUM ('new', 'learning', 'mastered');

-- ============================================
-- TABLE: aip_levels
-- Belt levels and Position School tracks
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE aip_levels (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  type aip_level_type NOT NULL,
  track_number TEXT,
  prerequisite_level_id UUID REFERENCES aip_levels(id),
  passing_threshold INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 80,
  scripts_start INTEGER,
  scripts_end INTEGER,
  cumulative_instruments INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE aip_levels ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "aip_levels_public_read" ON aip_levels FOR SELECT USING (true);

-- ============================================
-- TABLE: aip_scripts
-- The 70-script Communication Language System
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE aip_scripts (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  script_number INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  script_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  belt_level_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_levels(id),
  primary_function TEXT NOT NULL,
  approved_language TEXT,
  forbidden_phrases TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
  patient_safety_rationale TEXT,
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE aip_scripts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "aip_scripts_public_read" ON aip_scripts FOR SELECT USING (true);

-- ============================================
-- TABLE: aip_instruments
-- 100-instrument mastery database
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE aip_instruments (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  instrument_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  instrument_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  category TEXT NOT NULL,
  identification_notes TEXT,
  lead_decision_notes TEXT,
  inspection_criteria TEXT,
  belt_level_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_levels(id),
  tray_sets TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE aip_instruments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "aip_instruments_public_read" ON aip_instruments FOR SELECT USING (true);

-- ============================================
-- TABLE: aip_vocabulary
-- Terms and definitions by level
-- ============================================
CREATE TABLE aip_vocabulary (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  level_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_levels(id),
  term TEXT NOT NULL,
  definition TEXT NOT NULL,
  area TEXT DEFAULT 'general',
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

);

ALTER TABLE aip_vocabulary ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "aip_vocabulary_public_read" ON aip_vocabulary FOR SELECT USING (true);

-- ============================================
-- TABLE: aip_formulas

CREATE TABLE aip_formulas (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

(11, 'Missing / Wrong Count Sheet (Reporting Side)', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'Stop work. Notify Lead. No memory substitution.', NULL, ARRAY['I remember what goes in there', 'I have done this tray before'], 'Memory substitution is forbidden. The count sheet is the authority document.');

-- GREEN BELT (Scripts 12-20)
INSERT INTO aip_scripts (script_number, script_name, belt_level_id, primary_function, approved_language, forbidden_phrases, patient_safety_rationale) VALUES
(12, 'Universal Communication Protocol', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'Acknowledge. Clarify. Confirm. Commit. Foundation of all scripts.', NULL, ARRAY['I will try', 'Someone will handle it', 'I think so'], 'UCP ensures every communication has clear ownership, specific action, and confirmed understanding.'),
(13, 'Instrument Count & Case Cart Verification (Full Protocol)', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'Cross-area full verification. Release statement.', NULL, ARRAY['Looks good'], 'Release statement requires verified count, not visual impression.'),
(14, 'Case Cart Communication (Tech Portions)', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'Internal status reporting to Lead with counts and pending items.', NULL, ARRAY['Almost done', 'Working on it'], 'Status must include specific counts and specific pending items.'),
(15, 'Tray Alignment & Set Standardization', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'Report deviation. No changes made. Await Lead direction.', NULL, ARRAY['I know how it should go', 'I fixed it'], 'Build sheet is the authority. Any deviation is reported, not corrected independently.'),
(16, 'Case Cart Discrepancy & Missing Item', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'Structured search. Document. Notify Lead.', NULL, ARRAY['It must be around here somewhere'], 'Structured search covers defined areas. Documentation before escalation.'),
(17, 'Missing / Wrong Count Sheet (All Areas)', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'All areas. Stop work. Notify Lead.', NULL, ARRAY['I remember what goes in there'], 'Memory substitution forbidden across all workflow areas.'),
(18, 'Tray Verification & Double-Signature Release', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'First verifier. Independent count, condition, completeness.', NULL, ARRAY['I trust the other person counted'], 'Trust is not verification. Double-signature requires independent verification.'),
(19, 'Tray Count Discrepancy', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'Structured search. Document areas searched. Notify Lead.', NULL, ARRAY['It is probably fine'], 'Count discrepancies are investigated, not assumed resolved.'),
(20, 'Coaching Lower Belt Script Adherence', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'Describe. Reference. Model. Confirm. Non-punitive.', NULL, ARRAY['You are doing it wrong', 'That is not how we do things'], 'Coaching references the script standard, not personal opinion. Non-punitive model produces behavior change.');

name: seed_aip_scripts_blue_belt
statements:
-- ============================================
-- SEED: Scripts 21-63 (Blue Belt)
-- ============================================
INSERT INTO aip_scripts (script_number, script_name, belt_level_id, primary_function, approved_language, forbidden_phrases, patient_safety_rationale) VALUES
(21, 'Shift Handoff Communication', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Open items, equipment, staffing. Full transfer.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(22, 'Cross-Shift Accountability & Blame-Free Communication', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Process gap language. No names. Current status and fix.', NULL, ARRAY['The night shift messed up', 'Who did this?'], 'Naming individuals shifts focus from process to blame. Process gap language enables correction.'),
(23, 'Shift Handoff & Cross-Shift (Full Protocol)', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'All areas, STATs, vendors, equipment, investigations.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(24, 'Multi-Shift / Weekend / Cross-Functional Handoff', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', '48-hour coverage. Written documentation location.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(25, 'Case Cart Delay Notification', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Proactive. Specific cause, revised time, interim.', NULL, ARRAY['Soon', 'Shortly', 'When we can'], 'Vague timeframes leave OR without actionable information.'),
(26, 'Tray Error Communication', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Lead-to-OR. Error identified, corrective action, timeline.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(27, 'Tray Error Reporting & Escalation', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Error requiring investigation. Chain-of-custody. Escalate.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(28, 'Instrument Damage / Missing Instrument Notification', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Lead-to-OR. Specific instrument, resolution, timeline.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(29, 'STAT Case Communication', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Immediate acknowledgment. Resources reallocated. Timeline. Update checkpoint.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(30, 'Case Add-On Notification & Verification', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Acknowledge. Availability. Timeline. Conflicts. Confirmation time.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(31, 'STAT / Emergency Case Communication (Full Protocol)', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Multi-case activation. Priority sequence. Resource allocation. Update cadence.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(32, 'OR Complaint / Issue Response', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Neutral acknowledgment. Document. Investigate. Response timeline.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(33, 'OR Turnover Delay Communication', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Specific cause. Revised readiness time. Interim actions.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(34, 'Late Tray Arrival to OR', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Revised arrival time. Specific reason. Confirm delivery.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(35, 'Missing Instrument Investigation', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Systematic search. Areas completed. Update intervals.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(36, 'Case Start Time Verification', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'SPD readiness verified. Conflicts identified. Proactive.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(37, 'Case Cancellation / Case Change', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Acknowledged. Tray recovery. Schedule adjustment. Parties notified.', NULL, ARRAY['Again?', 'We already built everything', 'Whatever', 'Fine'], 'Case cancellation is operational adjustment, not emotional event.'),
(38, 'Add-On / STAT / Emergency Case Activation', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Activation received. Resource assessment. Timeline. Update interval.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(39, 'Wrong Tray Pulled / Wrong Set Delivered', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Immediate notification. Retrieval. Correct tray. Timeline.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(40, 'Delay Communication (All Areas)', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Source, impact, revised timeline, mitigation. All affected parties.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(41, 'Missing Instrument / Missing Tray / Incomplete Set', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Investigation. Search status. Expected resolution.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(42, 'Wrong Instrument / Tray Delivered to OR', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Confirmed. Retrieval coordinated. Correct item. Timeline.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(43, 'Delayed Case Cart / Where Is Our Case Cart?', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Current status. Specific item. Delivery time. Update commitment.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(44, 'Vendor Tray Arrival & Incomplete Tray', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Verify. Document discrepancy. Notify vendor.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(45, 'Vendor Tray Intake, Verification & Compliance', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Full intake. Documentation, inspection, count, compliance status.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(46, 'Vendor Tray Arrival, Verification & Conflict Prevention', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Non-negotiable processing. Professional hold of SPD authority.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(47, 'Vendor Management & External Rep Protocol', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'What SPD shares and what requires Lead approval.', NULL, '{}', 'Case schedules, surgeon preferences, and patient information are never shared with vendor reps.'),
(48, 'Vendor Loaner Tray Drop-Off, Pick-Up & Documentation', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Chain-of-custody from drop-off to return.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(49, 'Missing Vendor Items & Vendor Accountability', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Formal notice. Documentation. Resolution deadline. Escalation path.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(50, 'Downtime / Tracking System Outage', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Manual backup activated. All staff notified. Updates at intervals.', 'Tracking system outage reported at [time]. Manual backup procedures activated. All staff notified. Documentation on [paper/backup system] until restoration.', '{}', NULL),
(51, 'Patient Safety Incident & Near-Miss Reporting', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Immediate containment. Evidence preserved. Formal report. Escalated.', NULL, ARRAY['Nobody got hurt'], 'Near-misses receive same documentation and reporting as incidents.'),
(52, 'Instrument Damage Reporting & Escalation', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Photo documented. Removed from service. Replacement sourced. Vendor notified.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(53, 'Incident Reporting & Documentation', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Event type, roles, timeline, immediate actions, root-cause indicators.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(54, 'Lost Instrument & Missing Item Protocol', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Systematic search. Chain-of-custody review. Escalation timeline.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(55, 'Broken / Damaged / Rusty / Unsafe Instrument', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Quarantined. Removed. Will not return until condition met.', NULL, ARRAY['The surgeon will not notice', 'It is just a little rust'], 'Any phrase minimizing a defect implies the instrument will still be used. It will not.'),
(56, 'Quality Event, Incident Reporting & Chain-of-Custody', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Complete chain-of-custody. Who, when, where, what done.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(57, 'Implant Verification & Documentation', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Type, size, lot, expiration, condition. All fields documented.', NULL, ARRAY['The vendor confirmed it'], 'Verbal vendor confirmation is not SPD verification. The Lead verifies each data point independently.'),
(58, 'Wrong Implant / Implant Confirmation', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Hold immediately. Verification in progress. OR notified. Resolution with timeline.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(59, 'High-Emotion OR Calls & Surgeon De-Escalation', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Acknowledge urgency. Facts. Actions. Timeline. Never match emotion.', NULL, '{}', 'Matching emotion escalates conflict. Facts and timeline de-escalate.'),
(60, 'OR Blaming SPD / Conflict De-Escalation', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Facts and timeline. Regardless of source, here is resolution. Follow-up.', 'I understand the frustration. Let me review the documentation: [facts and timeline]. Regardless of the source, here is what we are doing to resolve it: [actions]. I will follow up at [time].', ARRAY['That is not our fault', 'We did everything right'], 'Counter-blame escalates conflict. The Lead''s job is resolution, not vindication.'),
(61, 'OR Requesting IUSS / Unsafe IUSS Requests', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Criteria-based. Decline if not met. Safe alternative. Timeline.', NULL, ARRAY['I guess it is okay this one time', 'The surgeon said to do it', 'If administration says so'], 'IUSS criteria are clinical safety criteria. Administrative or surgeon authority does not override them.'),
(62, 'OR Claims Tray Never Received', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Documentation review. Coordinate search. No blame. Update time.', 'I am reviewing our delivery documentation. Records show [tray] was delivered to [location] at [time] by [name]. Let me coordinate a search of [areas]. I will update you in [time].', '{}', NULL),
(63, 'SPD is Slow / Urgency Neutralization', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'Specific facts. Specific status. Specific time. Do not absorb characterization.', NULL, '{}', 'Never validate characterizations. Respond with specific facts and timeline.');

name: seed_aip_scripts_brown_belt
statements:
-- ============================================
-- SEED: Scripts 64-70 (Brown Belt)
-- ============================================
INSERT INTO aip_scripts (script_number, script_name, belt_level_id, primary_function, approved_language, forbidden_phrases, patient_safety_rationale) VALUES
(64, 'Cross-Department Escalation', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000005', 'Pattern data, multi-dept impact, proposed action, leadership review request.', NULL, '{}', 'Cross-department escalation requires data, not complaints. Pattern data drives action.'),
(65, 'Error Correction & Root-Cause Communication', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000005', 'Data findings, process failure, proposed correction, implementation timeline.', NULL, ARRAY['It was human error', 'They need to be more careful'], 'Human error ends analysis at the person. Process gap language enables systemic correction.'),
(66, 'Leadership Support & Incident Escalation', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000005', 'Status, actions taken, specific support needed, impact if unresolved.', NULL, ARRAY['I just wanted to share the findings'], 'Brown Belt presentations always end with a specific request. Sharing findings without a request is incomplete.'),
(67, 'Equipment Failure, Repair Request & Downtime', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000005', 'Impact scope, biomed notified, estimated downtime, contingency.', NULL, '{}', NULL),
(68, 'Contaminated Instruments Found in OR / Bioburden', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000005', 'Critical event. Full notification chain. Containment. Quarantine. Investigation.', NULL, ARRAY['It might be nothing', 'Do not worry the OR about this', 'Can we keep this quiet'], 'Contamination events are never treated as uncertain. Notification chain: SPD Lead, OR charge nurse, infection prevention, risk management.'),
(69, 'Sterilizer Failure, Load Recall & System-Wide Notification', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000005', 'Confirmed failure. Full recall. Track all trays. Notify all departments.', NULL, ARRAY['Only a few trays were affected'], 'Scope is determined by complete cycle tracking, not estimation. Estimating scope creates recall gaps.'),
(70, 'Patient Safety Escalation, Risk Notification & Executive-Level', 'a0000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000005', 'Highest level. Executive leadership, risk management, patient safety officers.', NULL, ARRAY['Can we handle this internally?'], 'Script 70 events require institutional response by definition. Internal containment is one step, not the complete response.');

-- Answers for S51-100 (general expected responses based on WB principles)
INSERT INTO aip_answers (question_id,answer_text,answer_component,sort_order,source_reference) VALUES
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000051','Hold the item. Document the finding. Notify the Lead immediately. A CI that did not change indicates potential sterilization failure.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000052','Not within White Belt scope. Route to Lead. Script 2 applies only when items are ready.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000053','Document the observation. Notify the Lead. Timeline commitments are outside White Belt scope.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000054','Documentation is required for every exchange regardless of urgency. Hold the exchange.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000055','Answer the first call with Script 1. Place on hold. Answer second. Route both to Lead.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000056','Route to the Lead. Do not provide tray location or status. Script 1 applies in person too.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000057','Hold the script. Say Script 1 calmly. Do not match the emotion. Document and route.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000058','Notify the Lead. Vendor trays do not bypass SPD processing. Route to Lead for disposition.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000059','Not within White Belt scope. Route to Lead.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000060','If assigned to the phone, maintain that position. Use Script 1 for all calls.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000061','Prioritization is a Lead decision. Route to Lead. Do not make prioritization commitments.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000062','Document the return. Notify the Lead. Do not attempt to resolve independently.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000063','Script 1. Route to Lead. Surgeon or not, the script applies to everyone.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000064','Document the observation. Notify the Lead. White Belt does not have coaching authority.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000065','Accept the list, document it, and route to the Lead. Do not pull items independently.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000066','Complete the runner exchange first (active task), then answer the phone.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000067','Document the request. Route to Lead. Do not accept preference card changes at White Belt.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000068','Hold the instrument. Document the finding. Notify the Lead. Do not use or discard.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000069','Document the call. Route to Lead again. The script does not change because of prior contact.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000070','Do not sign. Notify the Lead. Unknown forms require Lead review.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000071','Document and route to your Lead. Do not act on another Lead''s verbal authorization.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000072','Hold the tray. Document the finding. Notify the Lead. Potential contamination event.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000073','Route to Lead. A physician does not bypass SPD protocol. Script applies regardless of title.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000074','Documentation is required for every exchange. Even Lead direction does not override this standard.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000075','Script 1. Physician or not, the script applies. Route to Lead.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000076','Route to Lead. Explaining the SBD system to visitors is not White Belt scope.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000077','Hold the item. Do not release. Document. Notify the Lead. Expired items are not sterile.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000078','Hold the script. Document the threat. Route to Lead. Do not deviate regardless of pressure.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000079','Document the return. Notify the Lead. Missing instrument is a Lead-level investigation.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000080','Locate the next available Supervisor. Document the situation. Do not act as Lead.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000081','Document the finding immediately. Notify the Lead or Supervisor. This is a process failure event.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000082','Acknowledge the question. Explain that the scripts protect patient safety. Route further questions to Lead.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000083','Hold the script. Document the call with urgency. Route to Lead immediately. This is a critical event.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000084','Stop. Do not touch. Preserve evidence. Notify Lead immediately. Potential contamination event.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000085','Route to Lead. SPD does not share information with vendors at White Belt level.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000086','Stay at your assigned post. Phone coverage is your assignment. Notify Lead of the request.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000087','Document the return. Notify Lead. Do not attempt to identify or resolve the error.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000088','Hold the script. Do not absorb the characterization. Document. Route to Lead.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000089','Document what you observed. Notify the Lead immediately. This is a safety concern.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000090','Route to Lead. Status reporting is not within White Belt scope.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000091','Notify the Lead. Reconstruct documentation from memory for events you participated in. Flag the gap.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000092','Stop. Contain the item. Do not touch the sterile area. Notify Lead. This is a critical contamination event.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000093','Script 1 applies regardless. Route to Lead. The caller does not decide what scope applies.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000094','Notify the Lead or Supervisor. Document the outage time. Follow facility emergency protocol.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000095','Do not use. Document location found. Notify Lead. The instrument requires reprocessing.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000096','Scripts always apply. Document the statement. Notify Lead. Weekend does not change the standard.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000097','Stop. Do not reach in. Document the finding. Notify Lead. This is a sharps safety event.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000098','Document the fourth call. Escalate to Supervisor if Lead is unavailable. OR cannot be left without follow-up.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000099','Document what you recognize. Notify Lead immediately. Do not process without Lead direction.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000001-0000-0000-0001-000000000100','Schedule your Level 1 and Level 2 assessments with your facilitator.','expected_response',0,'WB_Facilitator_Guide');

INSERT INTO aip_answers (question_id,answer_text,answer_component,sort_order,source_reference) VALUES
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid,'Scripts 3, 6, and 9 for Decontam. Scripts 4, 10, 11, and 18 for Assembly. Scripts 5, 7, and 8 for Sterilization. Total 9 new scripts plus 2 carry-forward.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'::uuid,'I am reporting... and Requesting verification on...','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'::uuid,'Cleaning action taken by OR staff at the bedside immediately after instrument use to remove gross soil and prevent drying before transport to SPD.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000004'::uuid,'A hollow internal channel in an instrument. Automated washers cannot fully clean lumens. Manual cleaning and flushing are required.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000005'::uuid,'Contaminated instruments move in one direction only: from dirty receipt to clean handoff. No contaminated items travel backward into the clean side.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000006'::uuid,'Hand-washing of instruments before automated processing. Required for hinged instruments, lumens, and instruments with complex geometry.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000007'::uuid,'A cleaning solution containing enzymes that break down protein-based organic matter on instruments.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000008'::uuid,'Automated cleaning equipment that processes instruments through a high-temperature wash cycle. It does not sterilize.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000009'::uuid,'The visual and functional check performed on every instrument before assembly. Includes damage, corrosion, missing parts, proper function, and cleanliness.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000010'::uuid,'The functional test of a clamping instrument ratchet: clicks securely through all positions and releases cleanly. Instruments that fail are removed from service.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000011'::uuid,'The protocol requiring two authorized personnel to verify and sign off on a completed tray before it advances to sterilization.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000012'::uuid,'A packaging material for individual instruments with a paper side allowing steam penetration and a clear plastic side. Sealed on both ends.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000013'::uuid,'The process of counting every instrument against the count sheet before closing a tray. Every item must match. Discrepancies stop the process.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000014'::uuid,'The principle that packaged sterile items remain sterile until an event (moisture, tear, drop, pressure) compromises the package.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000015'::uuid,'Gravity: steam enters and air falls out through drain. Used for unwrapped solids. Prevac: air is actively removed by vacuum first. Required for wrapped sets and lumened instruments.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000016'::uuid,'The specific temperature, pressure, and time values that must be met for a cycle to be valid.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000017'::uuid,'A sterilized item that is wet at point of release. Considered unsterile. Must be held, documented, Lead notified, never released.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000018'::uuid,'Any condition where packaging has been compromised: wet pack, torn wrap, failed seal, damaged packaging. Item is considered unsterile.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000019'::uuid,'Stop processing, preserve the item, document the finding, notify Lead using Script 6.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000020'::uuid,'Separating incoming contaminated instruments by type, specialty, material, and processing requirements before cleaning begins.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000021'::uuid,'Stop assembly, report to Lead using Script 4, await Lead direction.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000022'::uuid,'Stop work on that tray, report to Lead using Script 11, do not assemble without the correct count sheet.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000023'::uuid,'The probability that a single unit is not sterile. Standard for surgical instruments is 10^-6 (one in one million).','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000024'::uuid,'The written or electronic record of every sterilization load including contents, cycle type, cycle number, date, time, and operator.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000025'::uuid,'No. Release requires verification of all parameters and Lead or authorized supervisor sign-off.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000026'::uuid,'Absorbent material placed inside instrument trays to absorb condensation during sterilization and prevent wet packs.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000027'::uuid,'To identify soil, corrosion, cracks, or damage not visible to the naked eye during instrument inspection.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000028'::uuid,'Insulation integrity, jaw closure and ratchet function, lumen patency.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000029'::uuid,'A cutting/biting instrument for bone and dense tissue. Key inspection: footplate and cutting edge for chips and cracks.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000030'::uuid,'Dissecting instrument used to strip periosteum from bone. Key inspection: blade edge for chips and curling.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000031'::uuid,'I am reporting a wet [load/pack] on sterilizer [number]. Cycle [number]. The load has been held. I have preserved the items and documented the finding. Notifying Lead.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000032'::uuid,'Any three correct forbidden phrases from Scripts 3-11 with explanation of why each is forbidden.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000033'::uuid,'CI: changes color to show exposure to sterilization conditions. BI: contains living spores to verify sterilization actually kills organisms. Both are required.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000034'::uuid,'Combined suction and irrigation instrument. Key inspection: lumen patency, all ports clear, seal integrity.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000035'::uuid,'Document receipt (room, time, items, condition), enter decontam processing per standard protocol, notify Lead using Script 9.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000036'::uuid,'The hinge mechanism of ratcheted instruments. Removed from service if excessive play, misaligned jaws, grinding, or resistance.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000037'::uuid,'The condition of a wrapped or pouched item confirming the wrap is complete, sealed, and uncompromised before sterilization.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000038'::uuid,'The time required to destroy 90% of a microbial population at a given temperature. Basis for sterilization cycle validation.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000039'::uuid,'Hold the load, document the finding, notify Lead using Script 5 immediately.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000040'::uuid,'The solid inner stylet inserted through a trocar to create the initial access point. Inspected for burrs or damage.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000041'::uuid,'Remove the instrument from the tray, set aside, document the finding, notify Lead. Do not include the instrument in the set.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000042'::uuid,'Pre-treatment step where instruments are submerged in enzymatic solution to soften dried soil before manual cleaning.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000043'::uuid,'Cuts and removes bone or dense tissue. Key inspection: cutting edges for chips, sharpness.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000044'::uuid,'A scooping instrument used to remove tissue or bone. Key inspection: cup edge for chips or deformity.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000045'::uuid,'No. Re-running a cycle is an unauthorized decision. Lead must be notified and must authorize any re-run.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000046'::uuid,'Retracting and dissecting instrument for neurosurgical procedures. Key inspection: tip integrity, shaft for kinks or cracks.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000002-0000-0000-0000-000000000047'::uuid,'A wire saw for bone cutting. Key inspection: wire for kinks or breaks, handle attachment security.','full_answer',0,'YB_Facilitator_Guide'),

INSERT INTO aip_answers (question_id,answer_text,answer_component,sort_order,source_reference) VALUES
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid,'Emotional regulation. The Lead is the calmest person in the room.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'::uuid,'Every external call starts with: This is [name], SPD Lead. Name and role ground the communication.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'::uuid,'Defined update intervals. OR gets updates at specific times to prevent repeat calls.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000004'::uuid,'Before fixing anything, document it. Documentation is the chain of custody and quality record.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000005'::uuid,'Communication that identifies event and process gap without attaching blame to named individuals.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000006'::uuid,'Responding to non-specific pressure with specific facts and timeline. Not absorbing characterization.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000007'::uuid,'Full status by area, pending STATs, vendor status, equipment alerts, staffing, open investigations.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000008'::uuid,'A handoff where incoming Lead cannot describe current state is a failed handoff.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000009'::uuid,'Prior shift failures addressed as process gaps, not personnel failures. Incoming Lead inherits problem not blame.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000010'::uuid,'This is [name], SPD Lead. Case cart for [room/case] delayed. Reason: [specific]. Revised delivery: [time].','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000011'::uuid,'STAT acknowledged for [room/case/surgeon]. Resources reallocated. Estimated delivery: [time]. Update at [checkpoint].','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000012'::uuid,'I hear your concern. Documenting now. Will investigate and provide response by [time].','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000013'::uuid,'I understand urgency. Here is what we know: [facts]. Here is what we are doing: [actions]. Update in [time].','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000014'::uuid,'Dismissive of caller urgency. Escalates rather than de-escalates. Shifts focus from problem to person.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000015'::uuid,'I understand the frustration. Let me review documentation: [facts]. Here is resolution: [actions]. Follow up at [time].','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000016'::uuid,'Counter-blame escalates conflict. Lead''s job is resolution, not vindication.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000017'::uuid,'IUSS must meet defined facility criteria. Lead does not authorize outside criteria regardless of pressure.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000018'::uuid,'I guess it is okay this one time or The surgeon said to do it. Both abandon the safety position.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000019'::uuid,'SPD is Slow / Urgency Neutralization. Respond with specific facts and timeline. Never validate characterization.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),

('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000030'::uuid,'The surgeon will not notice or It is just a little rust. Any phrase minimizing defect is forbidden.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000031'::uuid,'Script 35: single missing instrument investigation. Script 41: broader missing instrument/tray/incomplete set.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000032'::uuid,'Reviewing delivery documentation. Records show [tray] delivered to [location] at [time] by [name]. Coordinating search.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000033'::uuid,'Acknowledge cancellation, communicate tray recovery/redirection, notify affected parties.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000034'::uuid,'Used to divide sternum in cardiac surgery. Inspect blade mount and guard mechanism.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000035'::uuid,'Applies titanium clips to blood vessels laparoscopically or in open surgery.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000036'::uuid,'Ultrasonic energy device. Requires manufacturer-specific cleaning protocol.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000037'::uuid,'Tissue fusion instrument for vessel sealing. Inspect jaw surfaces and cable integrity.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000038'::uuid,'Silicone loops for vessel identification and retraction. Single-use. Verify before reprocessing.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000039'::uuid,'Rigid scope for bladder examination. Inspect optics, light post, and seals.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000040'::uuid,'Flexible scope for ureteral/renal access. Leak test required. Channel inspection mandatory.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000041'::uuid,'Ultrasonic handpiece for cataract removal. Manufacturer-specific cleaning protocol required.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000042'::uuid,'Multi-case resource triage, priority sequencing, defined update cadence for all affected parties.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000043'::uuid,'We are not slow / We are understaffed / You have no idea what we deal with / Relax. All forbidden.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000044'::uuid,'Lead verifies SPD readiness aligns with posted case start time. Reports ready or flags conflicts.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000045'::uuid,'Powered shaver for arthroscopy. Full disassembly required. Inspect all ports and suction channels.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000046'::uuid,'No. Documenting it does not make unsafe IUSS safe. This phrase abandons the safety position.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000047'::uuid,'Script 26: Lead-to-OR tray error communication. Script 27: internal documentation and escalation for investigation.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000048'::uuid,'Comprehensive delay notification: cause, impact scope, revised timeline, mitigation steps.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000004-0000-0000-0000-000000000049'::uuid,'Fine needle driver with spring-return for microsurgery. Inspect locking mechanism and tips under magnification.','full_answer',0,'BB_Facilitator_Guide'),

INSERT INTO aip_answers (question_id,answer_text,answer_component,sort_order,source_reference) VALUES
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid,'Traces event to systemic process failure. Question: what in the process allowed this and what change prevents recurrence.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'::uuid,'A specific deficiency in a process that allows error to occur or recur. Not a person''s mistake.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'::uuid,'Human error ends analysis at person. Process gap continues to system. Brown Belt always identifies process gap.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000004'::uuid,'Identify, Map, Data, Identify the Gap, Propose, Present.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000005'::uuid,'Quantified recurrence data: frequency, time period, conditions.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000006'::uuid,'Implementation owner, specific action, and implementation timeline.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000007'::uuid,'Specific data collected over defined period to confirm correction closed the gap.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000008'::uuid,'Cross-Department Escalation. Triggered when systemic issue crosses departmental boundaries.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000009'::uuid,'Pattern data, multi-department impact, proposed action, leadership review request. Complaints have no data.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000010'::uuid,'Error Correction and Root-Cause Communication. Formal RCA findings presentation.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000011'::uuid,'Data-driven findings, specific process failure, proposed systemic correction, implementation timeline.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000012'::uuid,'Ends analysis at person, prevents systemic correction, allows recurrence.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000013'::uuid,'Leadership Support and Incident Escalation. Requests authority exceeding Lead-level.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000014'::uuid,'Current status, actions taken, specific support needed, impact if unresolved.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000015'::uuid,'Equipment Failure, Repair Request, Downtime. System-level impact reporting.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000016'::uuid,'Impact assessment, biomed notification time, estimated downtime, contingency plan.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000017'::uuid,'Contaminated Instruments in OR/Bioburden. Chain: SPD Lead, OR charge, infection prevention, risk management.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000018'::uuid,'Contamination never treated as uncertain. Response calibrates to confirmed finding.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000019'::uuid,'Sterilizer Failure, Load Recall, System-Wide Notification. Full recall of affected cycles.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000020'::uuid,'Affected cycle range from sterilizer failure. Scope determined by tracking, not estimation.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000021'::uuid,'Complete cycle tracking determines scope. Estimation creates recall gaps.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000022'::uuid,'Patient Safety Escalation, Risk Notification, Executive-Level. Highest-level script.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000023'::uuid,'Executive leadership, risk management, patient safety officers.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000024'::uuid,'Event classification, time of discovery, scope of affected patients, containment actions, institutional response requested, documentation available.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000025'::uuid,'Script 70 requires institutional response. Internal containment is one step, not complete response.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000026'::uuid,'Patient safety event requiring formal investigation and institutional response.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000027'::uuid,'Notification to external regulatory bodies. Brown Belt identifies when required and escalates immediately.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000028'::uuid,'Event, pattern history, impact, current status, actions taken, specific leadership support requested.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000029'::uuid,'Organizational tier governing SPD, OR, PACU. Primary audience for Brown Belt RCA presentations.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000030'::uuid,'Systematic process of identifying, locating, quarantining all items from compromised sterilizer cycle.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000031'::uuid,'Biological contamination presence where sterility is expected.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000032'::uuid,'Immediate physical steps to prevent further spread. Precedes investigation.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000033'::uuid,'Coordinated organizational reaction involving leadership, risk management, potentially regulatory reporting.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000034'::uuid,'Data review across multiple events to identify recurring failure modes and systemic gaps.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000035'::uuid,'Quantified event frequency, time period, conditions. It keeps happening is not data.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000036'::uuid,'Pattern data, multi-department impact, proposed action, leadership review request.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000037'::uuid,'Event Summary, Pattern Data, Process Map, Process Gap, Proposed Correction, Verification Plan, Request.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000038'::uuid,'Specific request to leadership: approval, resources, authority, or decision.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000039'::uuid,'Sterilizer logs, incident reports, tray error logs, wet pack records, case cart discrepancies, vendor non-compliance, equipment maintenance, OTIS.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000040'::uuid,'OTIS provides integrated tracking: instrument tracking, case history, utilization, preference card accuracy.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000041'::uuid,'Change to process/protocol/system that closes gap and prevents recurrence. Systemic, not individual.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000042'::uuid,'Specific schedule with date, owner, verification point. ASAP is not acceptable.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000043'::uuid,'Brown Belt.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000044'::uuid,'Black Belt.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000045'::uuid,'Script 68. Immediate containment, full notification chain, investigation.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000046'::uuid,'Determine affected cycle range. All cycles quarantined pending full recall tracking.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000047'::uuid,'Script 51: Lead-level incident documentation. Script 70: executive-level institutional response activation.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000048'::uuid,'Brown Belt asks what in the process allowed it. Personal attribution forbidden.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000049'::uuid,'Total number and identity of all potentially compromised items from affected cycles.','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000005-0000-0000-0000-000000000050'::uuid,'80% (40 correct out of 50).','full_answer',0,'BrB_Facilitator_Guide');

('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000008'::uuid,'Documentation, Script adherence, Coaching, Handoff, Certification, Script currency.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000009'::uuid,'Weekly review of all shift documentation across all belt levels.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000010'::uuid,'Quarterly review of all 70 scripts against current operational patterns.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000011'::uuid,'Communication gap across operators. New scenario with no coverage. Consistent same-direction deviation. Forbidden language from inadequacy not ignorance. Context change.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000012'::uuid,'Document finding. Analyze (training vs language gap). Draft revision. Submit to SIPS. Communicate after approval.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),

('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000014'::uuid,'Ongoing documentation of adherence observations, deviation patterns, coaching events, certification outcomes, script currency across all shifts and belts.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000015'::uuid,'WB: direct demonstration, Scripts 1-2, pressure from memory. BrB: data-quality challenge, contradicting data to test composure.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000016'::uuid,'Content accuracy. Pressure application. Evaluation quality.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000017'::uuid,'All certification measured against same standard regardless of who the Black Belt is.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000018'::uuid,'System maintains standard without ongoing SIPS presence. Black Belt teaches, audits, evolves, certifies independently.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000019'::uuid,'Developing operators who can eventually reach Black Belt. Ultimate measure of effectiveness.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000020'::uuid,'70-script system is evolving operational tool, not fixed document. Black Belt leads growth through SIPS.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000021'::uuid,'Level 1 (90%), Teaching Demo, Blue Belt Certification Sim, Audit Presentation + Script Evolution Proposal.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000022'::uuid,'No. All four components must pass. No conditional advance.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000023'::uuid,'GB: UCP tested unexpectedly, coaching role-play. YB: area-specific physical scenarios, forbidden language identification.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000024'::uuid,'True development takes three years. Black Belt is evidence the system sustains itself.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000025'::uuid,'Script number, audit finding, gap analysis, proposed revised language. Submitted to SIPS.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000026'::uuid,'25 scenarios with pressure escalation. Tone assessed separately. Pass/fail documented per scenario.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000027'::uuid,'Systemic gap pattern, patient safety risk, or certification-level script misuse across multiple operators.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000028'::uuid,'Verify Script 21/23/24 elements present in every documented handoff and language meets standard.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000029'::uuid,'Script known but same-direction deviation suggests language gap, not training gap.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000030'::uuid,'Retraining plan by belt level: who is affected, what changed, what the new standard is.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000031'::uuid,'Verify GB coaching: correct script cited, four-step model executed, coaching documented.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000032'::uuid,'Verify BB certifications: correct pressure, tone assessed, scoring matches rubric.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000033'::uuid,'Invalid. GB does not hold BB certification authority. Candidate reassessed by Black Belt.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000034'::uuid,'Script number, date/shift, precise deviation, pattern frequency, recommended action.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000035'::uuid,'Describe, Reference, Model, Confirm. Green Belt coaching for WB and YB operators.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000036'::uuid,'No. Blue Belt certification authority belongs to Black Belt only.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000037'::uuid,'Scripts 59-63 De-escalation. Teaching requires sustained hostile pressure. Black Belt teaches tone under genuine pressure.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000038'::uuid,'70.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000039'::uuid,'Direct demonstration, pressure simulation escalating, recitation from memory, protection principle, zero improvisation demonstrated.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000040'::uuid,'Full 25-scenario simulation at certification pressure. Tone assessed. Hostile callers, blame-shifting, demanding surgeons.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000041'::uuid,'If operators deviate the same way knowingly, it is language gap. If from ignorance, training gap. Black Belt determines which before acting.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000042'::uuid,'Black Belt defines what excellent is. System standard set by what Black Belt teaches, audits, certifies.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000043'::uuid,'30 days of documented adherence data.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000044'::uuid,'Rejection documented with reason. Existing language remains. Additional data may support revised submission.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000045'::uuid,'SIPS does not exit until certified Brown Belt on site and Leadership Circle verified independent. Black Belt represents highest sustainability.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000046'::uuid,'Black Belt develops the system that produces, sustains, and evolves responses. System-level, not script-level.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000047'::uuid,'Assess if scripts cover new scenarios. Initiate revision review for gaps. Communicate revisions to all affected belts.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000048'::uuid,'Script adherence (verbal) and documentation audit (written) both required. Verbal without documentation is incomplete.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000049'::uuid,'Operators at every belt level who can teach, audit, sustain the system. Replication is the product.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000006-0000-0000-0000-000000000050'::uuid,'90% (45 correct out of 50). Certifier standard exceeds those being certified.','full_answer',0,'BkB_Facilitator_Guide');

INSERT INTO aip_answers (question_id,answer_text,answer_component,sort_order,source_reference) VALUES

('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000008'::uuid,'(On-time deliveries / Total deliveries) x 100.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000009'::uuid,'Every card has version number and date. Increments on update. Previous archived. Wrong version is a process failure.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000010'::uuid,'Item on card not used. Item used not on card. Wrong version (discontinued product).','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),

('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000012'::uuid,'Acknowledge, investigate, identify cause, respond with facts, document and close.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
