('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000014'::uuid,'Advance notice, receipt inspection, SPD processing, verification, delivery confirmation, post-case handling.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000015'::uuid,'Documented vendor tray discrepancy requiring formal notification, resolution timeline, and escalation path.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000016'::uuid,'Facts first, no emotional matching, no blame, every commitment has a time, proactive over reactive, neutral tone always.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),

('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000020'::uuid,'Acknowledge, investigate, identify cause, respond with facts and timeline, document and close.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000021'::uuid,'Status updates with specific facts, timelines, and commitments. No vague language. No emotional matching.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000022'::uuid,'Receipt, inspection, count verification, compliance check, processing assignment, documentation in OTIS.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000023'::uuid,'Defined schedule for reviewing and updating preference cards with surgeon confirmation. Quarterly minimum.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000024'::uuid,'Current, pending update, under review, new, discontinued.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000025'::uuid,'Case cart accuracy, on-time delivery, loaner status, preference card updates, OR communication logs in OTIS.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000026'::uuid,'Delivery verified: correct room, correct case, all items confirmed, circulator or designee accepts delivery.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000027'::uuid,'Notification when two cases require conflicting resources. Includes impact, options, and recommended resolution.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000028'::uuid,'Third documented occurrence within defined period. Pattern triggers formal escalation to Supervisor.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000029'::uuid,'Verified case cart staged in designated area with delivery time documented and OR notified.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000030'::uuid,'80% (40 correct out of 50).','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000031'::uuid,'Investigate decline. Audit case cart build process. Identify root cause. Issue corrective action with timeline.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000032'::uuid,'Document the request. Contact circulator to confirm. If confirmed, add to post-case discrepancy report for card update.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),

('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000035'::uuid,'Deny bypass at OR Liaison level. Tray enters SPD processing. Escalate to Supervisor. Non-negotiable standard.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000036'::uuid,'Acknowledge without defending. Investigate. Identify specific cause. Respond with facts and corrective action. Document.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000037'::uuid,'SPD processing capacity and workflow efficiency. Low rate indicates bottlenecks that need operational review.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000038'::uuid,'Adjust staging. Reassign cart if possible. Notify OR of any impact. Document schedule change and cart disposition.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),

('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000040'::uuid,'Confirm all instruments returned, decontaminated per IFU, returned to vendor per agreement. Document return.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000041'::uuid,'Stop build. Document discrepancy. Contact surgeon office for resolution. Do not build from outdated card.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000042'::uuid,'Case number, delivery time, items delivered, any substitutions, recipient name, discrepancies noted.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000043'::uuid,'Preference card match, instrument verification, supply verification, expiration check, packaging integrity, completeness sign-off.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000044'::uuid,'Clinical urgency first. Then time sensitivity. Then standard schedule. All communicated to OR with specific timelines.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000045'::uuid,'Minimum time from vendor receipt to case start allowing full SPD processing. Defined by facility policy.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000046'::uuid,'Deny bypass. Tray enters SPD processing. Escalate to Supervisor. Non-negotiable regardless of surgeon request.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000047'::uuid,'Daily next-day review. Weekly preference card status review. Monthly accuracy and on-time delivery metrics.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000048'::uuid,'Maintains version control log. Initiates updates within 48 hours of identified discrepancy. Archives old versions.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000049'::uuid,'Document as missed delivery. Notify Supervisor. Hold carts for next-day delivery. Do not deliver without proper verification.','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide'),
('b0000008-0000-0000-0000-000000000050'::uuid,'80% (40 correct out of 50).','full_answer',0,'ORL_Facilitator_Guide');

-- ============================================
-- RPC: generate_quiz
-- Core question selection algorithm
-- Returns questions WITHOUT answers (security)
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_generate_quiz(
  p_level_id UUID,
  p_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'practice_quiz',
  p_count INTEGER DEFAULT 25,
  p_categories TEXT[] DEFAULT NULL,
  p_difficulty_override JSONB DEFAULT NULL,
  p_parts TEXT[] DEFAULT NULL,
  p_exclude_ids UUID[] DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_easy_pct NUMERIC;
  v_med_pct NUMERIC;
  v_hard_pct NUMERIC;
  v_easy_count INTEGER;
  v_med_count INTEGER;
  v_hard_count INTEGER;
  v_passing INTEGER;
  v_level_code TEXT;
  v_attempt_id UUID;
  v_questions JSONB;
BEGIN
  -- Get level info
  SELECT code, passing_threshold INTO v_level_code, v_passing
  FROM aip_levels WHERE id = p_level_id;

  IF v_level_code IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Level not found');
  END IF;

  -- Determine difficulty distribution
  IF p_difficulty_override IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_easy_pct := (p_difficulty_override->>'easy')::NUMERIC / 100;
    v_med_pct := (p_difficulty_override->>'medium')::NUMERIC / 100;
    v_hard_pct := (p_difficulty_override->>'hard')::NUMERIC / 100;
  ELSIF p_mode = 'timed_test' THEN
    IF v_level_code = 'BkB' THEN
      v_easy_pct := 0.10; v_med_pct := 0.40; v_hard_pct := 0.50;
    ELSE
      v_easy_pct := 0.20; v_med_pct := 0.50; v_hard_pct := 0.30;
    END IF;
  ELSE
    v_easy_pct := 0.40; v_med_pct := 0.40; v_hard_pct := 0.20;
  END IF;

  v_easy_count := CEIL(p_count * v_easy_pct);
  v_hard_count := CEIL(p_count * v_hard_pct);
  v_med_count := p_count - v_easy_count - v_hard_count;
  IF v_med_count < 0 THEN v_med_count := 0; END IF;

  -- Create attempt record
  INSERT INTO aip_assessment_attempts (level_id, mode, total_questions, config)
  VALUES (
    p_level_id,
    p_mode::aip_assessment_mode,
    p_count,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'difficulty_distribution', jsonb_build_object('easy', v_easy_count, 'medium', v_med_count, 'hard', v_hard_count),
      'categories', p_categories,
      'parts', p_parts
    )
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_attempt_id;

  -- Select questions with difficulty distribution
  WITH easy_qs AS (
    SELECT id, question_number, question_text, question_type::TEXT, content_category::TEXT, difficulty::TEXT, part::TEXT, tags
    FROM aip_questions
    WHERE level_id = p_level_id
      AND is_active = true AND is_approved = true
      AND difficulty = 'easy'
      AND (p_categories IS NULL OR content_category::TEXT = ANY(p_categories))
      AND (p_parts IS NULL OR part::TEXT = ANY(p_parts))
      AND (p_exclude_ids IS NULL OR id != ALL(p_exclude_ids))
    ORDER BY random()
    LIMIT v_easy_count
  ),
  medium_qs AS (
    SELECT id, question_number, question_text, question_type::TEXT, content_category::TEXT, difficulty::TEXT, part::TEXT, tags
    FROM aip_questions
    WHERE level_id = p_level_id
      AND is_active = true AND is_approved = true
      AND difficulty = 'medium'
      AND (p_categories IS NULL OR content_category::TEXT = ANY(p_categories))
      AND (p_parts IS NULL OR part::TEXT = ANY(p_parts))
      AND (p_exclude_ids IS NULL OR id != ALL(p_exclude_ids))
    ORDER BY random()
    LIMIT v_med_count
  ),
  hard_qs AS (
    SELECT id, question_number, question_text, question_type::TEXT, content_category::TEXT, difficulty::TEXT, part::TEXT, tags
    FROM aip_questions
    WHERE level_id = p_level_id
      AND is_active = true AND is_approved = true
      AND difficulty = 'hard'
      AND (p_categories IS NULL OR content_category::TEXT = ANY(p_categories))
      AND (p_parts IS NULL OR part::TEXT = ANY(p_parts))
      AND (p_exclude_ids IS NULL OR id != ALL(p_exclude_ids))
    ORDER BY random()
    LIMIT v_hard_count
  ),
  all_qs AS (
    SELECT * FROM easy_qs
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM medium_qs
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM hard_qs
  )
  SELECT jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id', q.id,
      'question_number', q.question_number,
      'question_text', q.question_text,
      'question_type', q.question_type,
      'content_category', q.content_category,
      'difficulty', q.difficulty,
      'part', q.part,
      'tags', q.tags
    ) ORDER BY random()
  )
  INTO v_questions
  FROM all_qs q;

  -- Return quiz package (NO answers included)
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'attempt_id', v_attempt_id,
    'level_code', v_level_code,
    'mode', p_mode,
    'passing_threshold', v_passing,
    'total_questions', COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(v_questions), 0),
    'questions', COALESCE(v_questions, '[]'::jsonb)
  );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- RPC: submit_quiz
-- Scores responses, saves results, returns score
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_submit_quiz(
  p_attempt_id UUID,
  p_responses JSONB  -- Array of {question_id, candidate_answer}
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_response JSONB;
  v_question_id UUID;
  v_candidate_answer TEXT;
  v_correct_answer TEXT;
  v_is_correct BOOLEAN;
  v_correct_count INTEGER := 0;
  v_total INTEGER := 0;
  v_score_pct DECIMAL(5,2);
  v_passed BOOLEAN;
  v_passing_threshold INTEGER;
  v_level_id UUID;
  v_category_stats JSONB := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_cat TEXT;
  v_results JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- Get attempt info
  SELECT a.level_id, l.passing_threshold
  INTO v_level_id, v_passing_threshold
  FROM aip_assessment_attempts a
  JOIN aip_levels l ON l.id = a.level_id
  WHERE a.id = p_attempt_id;

  IF v_level_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Attempt not found');
  END IF;

  -- Process each response
  FOR v_response IN SELECT jsonb_array_elements(p_responses)
  LOOP
    v_question_id := (v_response->>'question_id')::UUID;
    v_candidate_answer := v_response->>'candidate_answer';
    v_total := v_total + 1;

    -- Get correct answer (first answer component)
    SELECT answer_text INTO v_correct_answer
    FROM aip_answers
    WHERE question_id = v_question_id
    AND (answer_component = 'full_answer' OR answer_component = 'expected_response')
    ORDER BY sort_order
    LIMIT 1;

    -- Simple scoring: mark as needs_manual_scoring for open-ended
    -- For now, all short_answer types need manual scoring
    v_is_correct := NULL;

    -- Save response
    INSERT INTO aip_question_responses (attempt_id, question_id, candidate_answer, is_correct, needs_manual_scoring)
    VALUES (p_attempt_id, v_question_id, v_candidate_answer, v_is_correct, true);

    -- Get category for stats
    SELECT content_category::TEXT INTO v_cat FROM aip_questions WHERE id = v_question_id;

    -- Build per-question result with answer (for practice mode)
    v_results := v_results || jsonb_build_object(
      'question_id', v_question_id,
      'candidate_answer', v_candidate_answer,
      'correct_answer', v_correct_answer,
      'needs_manual_scoring', true
    );
  END LOOP;

  -- Update attempt record
  UPDATE aip_assessment_attempts
  SET completed_at = now(),
      total_questions = v_total,
      correct_answers = v_correct_count,
      score_percentage = 0, -- Will be calculated after manual scoring
      passed = NULL -- Pending manual scoring
  WHERE id = p_attempt_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'attempt_id', p_attempt_id,
    'total_questions', v_total,
    'status', 'submitted_pending_review',
    'message', 'Responses saved. Open-ended questions require facilitator review for scoring.',
    'results', v_results
  );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- RPC: get_flashcard_deck
-- Returns flashcard set with spaced repetition
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_get_flashcard_deck(
  p_level_id UUID,
  p_candidate_email TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_deck_type TEXT DEFAULT 'questions',  -- 'questions', 'scripts', 'all'
  p_count INTEGER DEFAULT 20
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_cards JSONB;
BEGIN
  IF p_deck_type = 'scripts' OR p_deck_type = 'all' THEN
    -- Script flashcards: front = script name/number, back = function + approved language
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'card_id', s.id,
        'card_type', 'script',
        'front', 'Script ' || s.script_number || ': ' || s.script_name,
        'back', COALESCE(s.primary_function, '') || 
          CASE WHEN s.approved_language IS NOT NULL 
            THEN E'\n\nApproved Language: ' || s.approved_language 
            ELSE '' END ||
          CASE WHEN array_length(s.forbidden_phrases, 1) > 0 
            THEN E'\n\nForbidden: ' || array_to_string(s.forbidden_phrases, ', ')
            ELSE '' END,
        'difficulty', 'medium'
      ) ORDER BY random()
    )
    INTO v_cards
    FROM aip_scripts s
    WHERE s.belt_level_id = p_level_id
      AND s.is_active = true;
  END IF;

  IF p_deck_type = 'questions' OR p_deck_type = 'all' THEN
    -- Question flashcards: front = question, back = answer
    WITH q_cards AS (
      SELECT 
        q.id as card_id,
        'question' as card_type,
        q.question_text as front,
        COALESCE(a.answer_text, 'Answer pending review') as back,
        q.difficulty::TEXT as difficulty,
        fp.status as progress_status,
        fp.next_review_at
      FROM aip_questions q
      LEFT JOIN aip_answers a ON a.question_id = q.id AND a.sort_order = 0
      LEFT JOIN aip_flashcard_progress fp 
        ON fp.card_source_id = q.id 
        AND fp.card_source_type = 'question'
        AND fp.candidate_email = p_candidate_email
      WHERE q.level_id = p_level_id
        AND q.is_active = true AND q.is_approved = true
        AND a.id IS NOT NULL  -- Only include questions WITH answers
      ORDER BY
        -- Spaced repetition: due cards first, then new, then mastered
        CASE 
          WHEN fp.status IS NULL THEN 1  -- New cards
          WHEN fp.status = 'learning' AND (fp.next_review_at IS NULL OR fp.next_review_at <= now()) THEN 0  -- Due for review
          WHEN fp.status = 'mastered' AND (fp.next_review_at IS NULL OR fp.next_review_at <= now()) THEN 2  -- Mastered but due
          ELSE 3  -- Not yet due
        END,
        random()
      LIMIT p_count
    )
    SELECT COALESCE(v_cards, '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'card_id', card_id,
        'card_type', card_type,
        'front', front,
        'back', back,
        'difficulty', difficulty,
        'progress_status', COALESCE(progress_status::TEXT, 'new')
      )
    )
    INTO v_cards
    FROM q_cards;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'deck_size', COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(v_cards), 0),
    'cards', COALESCE(v_cards, '[]'::jsonb)
  );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- RPC: update_flashcard_progress
-- Updates spaced repetition tracking
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_update_flashcard_progress(
  p_candidate_email TEXT,
  p_card_source_id UUID,
  p_card_source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'question',
  p_got_it BOOLEAN DEFAULT false
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_record aip_flashcard_progress%ROWTYPE;
  v_new_status aip_flashcard_status;
  v_next_review TIMESTAMPTZ;
BEGIN
  -- Upsert progress record
  INSERT INTO aip_flashcard_progress (candidate_email, card_source_type, card_source_id, times_seen, times_correct, consecutive_correct, last_seen_at, status)
  VALUES (p_candidate_email, p_card_source_type, p_card_source_id, 1, 
    CASE WHEN p_got_it THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    CASE WHEN p_got_it THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    now(), 'learning')
  ON CONFLICT (candidate_email, card_source_type, card_source_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    times_seen = aip_flashcard_progress.times_seen + 1,
    times_correct = aip_flashcard_progress.times_correct + CASE WHEN p_got_it THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    consecutive_correct = CASE WHEN p_got_it THEN aip_flashcard_progress.consecutive_correct + 1 ELSE 0 END,
    last_seen_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING * INTO v_record;

  -- Determine new status and next review
  IF v_record.consecutive_correct >= 3 THEN
    v_new_status := 'mastered';
    v_next_review := now() + interval '7 days';
  ELSIF v_record.times_seen >= 1 THEN
    v_new_status := 'learning';
    IF p_got_it THEN
      v_next_review := now() + interval '1 day' * v_record.consecutive_correct;
    ELSE
      v_next_review := now() + interval '10 minutes';
    END IF;
  ELSE
    v_new_status := 'new';
    v_next_review := now();
  END IF;

  UPDATE aip_flashcard_progress
  SET status = v_new_status, next_review_at = v_next_review
  WHERE id = v_record.id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'card_source_id', p_card_source_id,
    'status', v_new_status::TEXT,
    'consecutive_correct', v_record.consecutive_correct,
    'times_seen', v_record.times_seen,
    'next_review_at', v_next_review
  );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- RPC: get_candidate_analytics
-- Dashboard metrics for a candidate
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_get_candidate_analytics(
  p_candidate_email TEXT
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_result JSONB;
BEGIN
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'total_attempts', COUNT(*),
    'total_questions_answered', SUM(total_questions),
    'average_score', ROUND(AVG(score_percentage), 1),
    'attempts_by_level', (
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'level_code', l.code,
        'level_name', l.name,
        'attempts', sub.cnt,
        'avg_score', sub.avg_score,
        'best_score', sub.best_score,
        'last_attempt', sub.last_attempt
      ) ORDER BY l.sort_order)
      FROM (
        SELECT level_id, COUNT(*) cnt, ROUND(AVG(score_percentage),1) avg_score,
               MAX(score_percentage) best_score, MAX(completed_at) last_attempt
        FROM aip_assessment_attempts
        WHERE candidate_email = p_candidate_email AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY level_id
      ) sub
      JOIN aip_levels l ON l.id = sub.level_id
    ),
    'flashcard_stats', (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'total_cards', COUNT(*),
        'mastered', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'mastered'),
        'learning', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'learning'),
        'new', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'new'),
        'mastery_rate', CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 
          THEN ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'mastered')::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) * 100, 1)
          ELSE 0 END
      )
      FROM aip_flashcard_progress
      WHERE candidate_email = p_candidate_email
    ),
    'recent_attempts', (
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', a.id,
        'level_code', l.code,
        'mode', a.mode::TEXT,
        'score', a.score_percentage,
        'passed', a.passed,
        'completed_at', a.completed_at,
        'total_questions', a.total_questions
      ) ORDER BY a.completed_at DESC)
      FROM (
        SELECT * FROM aip_assessment_attempts
        WHERE candidate_email = p_candidate_email AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 10
      ) a
      JOIN aip_levels l ON l.id = a.level_id
    )
  )
  INTO v_result
  FROM aip_assessment_attempts
  WHERE candidate_email = p_candidate_email;

  RETURN COALESCE(v_result, jsonb_build_object(
    'total_attempts', 0,
    'total_questions_answered', 0,
    'average_score', 0,
    'attempts_by_level', '[]'::jsonb,
    'flashcard_stats', jsonb_build_object('total_cards', 0, 'mastered', 0, 'learning', 0, 'new', 0, 'mastery_rate', 0),
    'recent_attempts', '[]'::jsonb
  ));
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- RPC: get_weak_areas
-- Identifies categories below 80% accuracy
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_get_weak_areas(
  p_candidate_email TEXT,
  p_level_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'category', category,
      'total', total,
      'correct', correct,
      'accuracy', accuracy,
      'is_weak', accuracy < 80
    ) ORDER BY accuracy ASC)
    FROM (
      SELECT 
        q.content_category::TEXT as category,
        COUNT(*) as total,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE qr.is_correct = true) as correct,
        ROUND(
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE qr.is_correct = true)::NUMERIC / 
          NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1
        ) as accuracy
      FROM aip_question_responses qr
      JOIN aip_assessment_attempts a ON a.id = qr.attempt_id
      JOIN aip_questions q ON q.id = qr.question_id
      WHERE a.candidate_email = p_candidate_email
        AND (p_level_id IS NULL OR a.level_id = p_level_id)
        AND qr.is_correct IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY q.content_category
      HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3  -- Minimum sample for meaningful data
    ) stats
  );
END;
$$;

-- RPC: Get answers for a question (admin use)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_get_question_answers(p_question_id UUID)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', a.id,
        'answer_text', a.answer_text,
        'answer_component', a.answer_component,
        'sort_order', a.sort_order,
        'source_reference', a.source_reference
      ) ORDER BY a.sort_order
    )
    FROM aip_answers a
    WHERE a.question_id = p_question_id
  );
END;
$$;

-- RPC: Get content stats for admin dashboard
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_get_admin_stats()
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'questions', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aip_questions),
    'answers', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aip_answers),
    'scripts', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aip_scripts),
    'levels', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aip_levels),
    'questions_with_answers', (
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.id) 
      FROM aip_questions q 
      JOIN aip_answers a ON a.question_id = q.id
    ),
    'by_level', (
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'code', l.code,
        'name', l.name,
        'questions', sub.q_count,
        'answers', sub.a_count,
        'knowledge', sub.k_count,
        'scenarios', sub.s_count
      ) ORDER BY l.sort_order)
      FROM (
        SELECT q.level_id,
          COUNT(*) as q_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.part = 'knowledge') as k_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.part = 'scenario') as s_count,
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aip_answers a WHERE a.question_id IN (
            SELECT id FROM aip_questions WHERE level_id = q.level_id
          )) as a_count
        FROM aip_questions q
        GROUP BY q.level_id
      ) sub
      JOIN aip_levels l ON l.id = sub.level_id
    )
  );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- AIP PLATFORM: Multi-Facility Assessment Management
-- ============================================

-- FACILITIES: Each hospital/department
CREATE TABLE aip_facilities (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  location TEXT,
  facility_code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,  -- short code e.g. "MEM-01"
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE aip_facilities ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "aip_facilities_read" ON aip_facilities FOR SELECT USING (true);

-- ADMIN USERS: SIPS-level and facility-level admins
CREATE TABLE aip_admin_users (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,         -- bcrypt or similar
  pin TEXT NOT NULL,                   -- 4-6 digit verification PIN
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'facility_admin',  -- 'sips_admin', 'facility_admin', 'educator'
  facility_id UUID REFERENCES aip_facilities(id),  -- NULL for sips_admin (sees all)
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  last_login_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE aip_admin_users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "aip_admin_read" ON aip_admin_users FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE INDEX idx_aip_admin_email ON aip_admin_users(email);

-- ASSESSORS / PROCTORS: On-site assessment proctors
CREATE TABLE aip_assessors (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  pin TEXT NOT NULL,                   -- proctor PIN for dual-authentication
  facility_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_facilities(id),
  belt_level TEXT,                     -- proctor's own belt level (must be >= candidate)
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE aip_assessors ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "aip_assessors_read" ON aip_assessors FOR SELECT USING (true);

-- CANDIDATES: Operators in the belt system
CREATE TABLE aip_candidates (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  password_hash TEXT,
  pin TEXT NOT NULL,                   -- candidate PIN for proctored tests
  first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  display_name TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (first_name || ' ' || last_name) STORED,
  facility_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_facilities(id),
  -- Competency levels (can differ per dimension)
  knowledge_level_id UUID REFERENCES aip_levels(id),   -- what level they test at for knowledge
  script_level_id UUID REFERENCES aip_levels(id),      -- what level for script competency
  practice_level_id UUID REFERENCES aip_levels(id),    -- what level they can practice at
  overall_belt_id UUID REFERENCES aip_levels(id),      -- their official belt designation
  assigned_by UUID REFERENCES aip_admin_users(id),
  enrollment_date DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE aip_candidates ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "aip_candidates_read" ON aip_candidates FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE INDEX idx_aip_candidates_facility ON aip_candidates(facility_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_aip_candidates_email ON aip_candidates(email);

-- ASSESSMENT REQUESTS: Candidate requests to take formal exam
CREATE TABLE aip_assessment_requests (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  candidate_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_candidates(id),
  level_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_levels(id),
  request_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'formal_exam',  -- 'formal_exam', 'simulation', 'placement'
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',             -- 'pending', 'approved', 'denied', 'completed', 'expired'
  requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  reviewed_by UUID REFERENCES aip_admin_users(id),
  reviewed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  review_notes TEXT,
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,            -- admin sets deadline for taking the test
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE aip_assessment_requests ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "aip_requests_read" ON aip_assessment_requests FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "aip_requests_insert" ON aip_assessment_requests FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE INDEX idx_aip_requests_candidate ON aip_assessment_requests(candidate_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_aip_requests_status ON aip_assessment_requests(status);

-- FORMAL ASSESSMENTS: Admin-approved available exams
CREATE TABLE aip_formal_assessments (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  request_id UUID REFERENCES aip_assessment_requests(id),
  candidate_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_candidates(id),
  level_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_levels(id),
  assessment_type TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 'level_1_knowledge', 'level_2_simulation', 'level_3_observation', 'placement'
  question_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50,
  time_limit_minutes INTEGER DEFAULT 60,
  passing_threshold INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 80,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available',  -- 'available', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'expired'
  available_from TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  available_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_by UUID REFERENCES aip_admin_users(id),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE aip_formal_assessments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "aip_formal_read" ON aip_formal_assessments FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE INDEX idx_aip_formal_candidate ON aip_formal_assessments(candidate_id);

-- PROCTORED SESSIONS: Dual-PIN authenticated test records
CREATE TABLE aip_proctored_sessions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  formal_assessment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_formal_assessments(id),
  candidate_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_candidates(id),
  assessor_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_assessors(id),
  facility_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_facilities(id),
  -- Authentication
  candidate_pin_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  assessor_pin_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  -- Session
  started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  -- Results
  attempt_id UUID REFERENCES aip_assessment_attempts(id),
  total_questions INTEGER,
  correct_answers INTEGER,
  score_percentage DECIMAL(5,2),
  passed BOOLEAN,
  -- Metadata
  proctor_notes TEXT,
  candidate_signature TEXT,          -- candidate confirms completion
  assessor_signature TEXT,           -- assessor confirms proctoring
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE aip_proctored_sessions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "aip_proctored_read" ON aip_proctored_sessions FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "aip_proctored_insert" ON aip_proctored_sessions FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE INDEX idx_aip_proctored_candidate ON aip_proctored_sessions(candidate_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_aip_proctored_facility ON aip_proctored_sessions(facility_id);

-- CANDIDATE LEVEL HISTORY: Track every level change
CREATE TABLE aip_candidate_level_history (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  candidate_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_candidates(id),
  dimension TEXT NOT NULL,           -- 'knowledge', 'script', 'practice', 'overall_belt'
  from_level_id UUID REFERENCES aip_levels(id),
  to_level_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES aip_levels(id),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,              -- 'placement', 'promotion', 'admin_override', 'assessment_passed'
  changed_by UUID REFERENCES aip_admin_users(id),
  proctored_session_id UUID REFERENCES aip_proctored_sessions(id),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
ALTER TABLE aip_candidate_level_history ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "aip_level_history_read" ON aip_candidate_level_history FOR SELECT USING (true);

-- ============================================
-- ADMIN LOGIN: email + password + PIN double auth
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_admin_login(
  p_email TEXT,
  p_password TEXT,
  p_pin TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE v_admin aip_admin_users%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_admin FROM aip_admin_users WHERE email = lower(p_email) AND is_active = true;
  IF v_admin.id IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('error','Invalid credentials'); END IF;
  -- Simple password check (production: use pgcrypto crypt/gen_salt)
  IF v_admin.password_hash != p_password THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('error','Invalid credentials'); END IF;
  -- PIN check if provided (second factor)
  IF p_pin IS NOT NULL AND v_admin.pin != p_pin THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('error','Invalid PIN'); END IF;
  -- Update last login
  UPDATE aip_admin_users SET last_login_at = now() WHERE id = v_admin.id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true, 'admin_id', v_admin.id, 'email', v_admin.email,
    'name', v_admin.display_name, 'role', v_admin.role,
    'facility_id', v_admin.facility_id,
    'pin_required', p_pin IS NULL  -- true if PIN still needed
  );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- CANDIDATE LOGIN: email + PIN
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_candidate_login(p_email TEXT, p_pin TEXT)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE v_c aip_candidates%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_c FROM aip_candidates WHERE email = lower(p_email) AND is_active = true;
  IF v_c.id IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('error','Account not found'); END IF;
  IF v_c.pin != p_pin THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('error','Invalid PIN'); END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true, 'candidate_id', v_c.id, 'email', v_c.email,
    'name', v_c.display_name, 'facility_id', v_c.facility_id,
    'knowledge_level_id', v_c.knowledge_level_id,
    'script_level_id', v_c.script_level_id,
    'practice_level_id', v_c.practice_level_id,
    'overall_belt_id', v_c.overall_belt_id
  );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- CANDIDATE PROFILE: What they see on their dashboard
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_get_candidate_profile(p_candidate_id UUID)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'candidate', jsonb_build_object(
        'id', c.id, 'name', c.display_name, 'email', c.email,
        'facility', f.name,
        'knowledge_level', kl.name, 'knowledge_code', kl.code,
        'script_level', sl.name, 'script_code', sl.code,
        'practice_level', pl.name, 'practice_code', pl.code,
        'overall_belt', ob.name, 'overall_belt_code', ob.code
      ),
      'available_assessments', (
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', fa.id, 'level', l.name, 'level_code', l.code,
          'type', fa.assessment_type, 'questions', fa.question_count,
          'time_limit', fa.time_limit_minutes, 'threshold', fa.passing_threshold,
          'available_until', fa.available_until
        )), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM aip_formal_assessments fa
        JOIN aip_levels l ON l.id = fa.level_id
        WHERE fa.candidate_id = p_candidate_id
        AND fa.status = 'available'
        AND (fa.available_until IS NULL OR fa.available_until > now())
      ),
      'pending_requests', (
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', ar.id, 'level', l.name, 'status', ar.status, 'requested_at', ar.requested_at
        )), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM aip_assessment_requests ar
        JOIN aip_levels l ON l.id = ar.level_id
        WHERE ar.candidate_id = p_candidate_id AND ar.status IN ('pending','approved')
      ),
      'completed_assessments', (
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'level', l.name, 'score', ps.score_percentage, 'passed', ps.passed,
          'date', ps.completed_at, 'assessor', a.display_name
        ) ORDER BY ps.completed_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM aip_proctored_sessions ps
        JOIN aip_formal_assessments fa ON fa.id = ps.formal_assessment_id
        JOIN aip_levels l ON l.id = fa.level_id
        LEFT JOIN aip_assessors a ON a.id = ps.assessor_id
        WHERE ps.candidate_id = p_candidate_id AND ps.completed_at IS NOT NULL
      )
    )
    FROM aip_candidates c
    LEFT JOIN aip_facilities f ON f.id = c.facility_id
    LEFT JOIN aip_levels kl ON kl.id = c.knowledge_level_id
    LEFT JOIN aip_levels sl ON sl.id = c.script_level_id
    LEFT JOIN aip_levels pl ON pl.id = c.practice_level_id
    LEFT JOIN aip_levels ob ON ob.id = c.overall_belt_id
    WHERE c.id = p_candidate_id
  );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- ADMIN DASHBOARD: All facilities, all candidates, testing status
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_get_admin_dashboard(
  p_admin_id UUID,
  p_facility_id UUID DEFAULT NULL  -- NULL = all facilities (sips_admin)
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE v_role TEXT; v_fid UUID;
BEGIN
  SELECT role, facility_id INTO v_role, v_fid FROM aip_admin_users WHERE id = p_admin_id;
  -- Facility admins only see their facility
  IF v_role != 'sips_admin' AND p_facility_id IS NULL THEN p_facility_id := v_fid; END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'facilities', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', f.id, 'name', f.name, 'code', f.facility_code, 'location', f.location,
        'candidate_count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aip_candidates WHERE facility_id = f.id AND is_active),
        'assessor_count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aip_assessors WHERE facility_id = f.id AND is_active)
      )), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM aip_facilities f WHERE f.is_active
      AND (p_facility_id IS NULL OR f.id = p_facility_id)
    ),
    'candidates', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', c.id, 'name', c.display_name, 'email', c.email,
        'facility', f.name, 'facility_code', f.facility_code,
        'overall_belt', l.name, 'belt_code', l.code,
        'knowledge_level', kl.code, 'script_level', sl.code
      ) ORDER BY f.name, c.last_name), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM aip_candidates c
      JOIN aip_facilities f ON f.id = c.facility_id
      LEFT JOIN aip_levels l ON l.id = c.overall_belt_id
      LEFT JOIN aip_levels kl ON kl.id = c.knowledge_level_id
      LEFT JOIN aip_levels sl ON sl.id = c.script_level_id
      WHERE c.is_active AND (p_facility_id IS NULL OR c.facility_id = p_facility_id)
    ),
    'pending_requests', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', ar.id, 'candidate_name', c.display_name,
        'facility', f.facility_code, 'level', l.name,
        'type', ar.request_type, 'requested_at', ar.requested_at
      ) ORDER BY ar.requested_at), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM aip_assessment_requests ar
      JOIN aip_candidates c ON c.id = ar.candidate_id
      JOIN aip_facilities f ON f.id = c.facility_id
      JOIN aip_levels l ON l.id = ar.level_id
      WHERE ar.status = 'pending'
      AND (p_facility_id IS NULL OR c.facility_id = p_facility_id)
    ),
    'recent_sessions', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'candidate', c.display_name, 'facility', f.facility_code,
        'level', l.name, 'score', ps.score_percentage,
        'passed', ps.passed, 'date', ps.completed_at,
        'assessor', a.display_name
      ) ORDER BY ps.completed_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM aip_proctored_sessions ps
      JOIN aip_candidates c ON c.id = ps.candidate_id
      JOIN aip_facilities f ON f.id = ps.facility_id
      JOIN aip_formal_assessments fa ON fa.id = ps.formal_assessment_id
      JOIN aip_levels l ON l.id = fa.level_id
      LEFT JOIN aip_assessors a ON a.id = ps.assessor_id
      WHERE ps.completed_at IS NOT NULL
      AND (p_facility_id IS NULL OR ps.facility_id = p_facility_id)
      LIMIT 20
    ),
    'content_stats', (SELECT aip_get_admin_stats())
  );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- REQUEST ASSESSMENT: Candidate requests formal exam
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_request_assessment(
  p_candidate_id UUID,
  p_level_id UUID,
  p_request_type TEXT DEFAULT 'formal_exam'
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE v_id UUID;
BEGIN
  -- Check for existing pending request
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aip_assessment_requests WHERE candidate_id = p_candidate_id AND level_id = p_level_id AND status = 'pending') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error','You already have a pending request for this level');
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO aip_assessment_requests (candidate_id, level_id, request_type)
  VALUES (p_candidate_id, p_level_id, p_request_type)
  RETURNING id INTO v_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'request_id', v_id);
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- APPROVE ASSESSMENT: Admin makes test available
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_approve_assessment(
  p_admin_id UUID,
  p_request_id UUID,
  p_assessment_type TEXT DEFAULT 'level_1_knowledge',
  p_question_count INTEGER DEFAULT 50,
  p_time_limit INTEGER DEFAULT 60,
  p_available_days INTEGER DEFAULT 14
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE v_req aip_assessment_requests%ROWTYPE; v_fa_id UUID;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_req FROM aip_assessment_requests WHERE id = p_request_id AND status = 'pending';
  IF v_req.id IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('error','Request not found or already processed'); END IF;
  -- Update request
  UPDATE aip_assessment_requests SET status = 'approved', reviewed_by = p_admin_id, reviewed_at = now(),
    expires_at = now() + (p_available_days || ' days')::interval WHERE id = p_request_id;
  -- Create formal assessment
  INSERT INTO aip_formal_assessments (request_id, candidate_id, level_id, assessment_type,
    question_count, time_limit_minutes, created_by, available_until)
  VALUES (p_request_id, v_req.candidate_id, v_req.level_id, p_assessment_type,
    p_question_count, p_time_limit, p_admin_id, now() + (p_available_days || ' days')::interval)
  RETURNING id INTO v_fa_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'formal_assessment_id', v_fa_id);
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- START PROCTORED SESSION: Dual-PIN authentication
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_start_proctored_session(
  p_formal_assessment_id UUID,
  p_candidate_pin TEXT,
  p_assessor_email TEXT,
  p_assessor_pin TEXT
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_fa aip_formal_assessments%ROWTYPE;
  v_cand aip_candidates%ROWTYPE;
  v_assessor aip_assessors%ROWTYPE;
  v_session_id UUID;
  v_attempt_id UUID;
  v_quiz JSONB;
BEGIN
  -- Validate formal assessment
  SELECT * INTO v_fa FROM aip_formal_assessments WHERE id = p_formal_assessment_id AND status = 'available';
  IF v_fa.id IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('error','Assessment not available'); END IF;
  -- Validate candidate PIN
  SELECT * INTO v_cand FROM aip_candidates WHERE id = v_fa.candidate_id;
  IF v_cand.pin != p_candidate_pin THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('error','Invalid candidate PIN'); END IF;
  -- Validate assessor PIN
  SELECT * INTO v_assessor FROM aip_assessors WHERE email = lower(p_assessor_email) AND is_active;
  IF v_assessor.id IS NULL OR v_assessor.pin != p_assessor_pin THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('error','Invalid assessor credentials'); END IF;
  -- Generate the quiz
  v_quiz := aip_generate_quiz(v_fa.level_id, 'timed_test', v_fa.question_count);
  v_attempt_id := (v_quiz->>'attempt_id')::UUID;
  -- Update attempt with candidate info
  UPDATE aip_assessment_attempts SET candidate_email = v_cand.email, candidate_id = v_cand.id WHERE id = v_attempt_id;
  -- Create proctored session
  INSERT INTO aip_proctored_sessions (formal_assessment_id, candidate_id, assessor_id, facility_id,
    candidate_pin_verified, assessor_pin_verified, attempt_id, total_questions)
  VALUES (p_formal_assessment_id, v_cand.id, v_assessor.id, v_cand.facility_id,
    true, true, v_attempt_id, v_fa.question_count)
  RETURNING id INTO v_session_id;
  -- Mark assessment as in progress
  UPDATE aip_formal_assessments SET status = 'in_progress' WHERE id = p_formal_assessment_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true, 'session_id', v_session_id, 'attempt_id', v_attempt_id,
    'candidate_name', v_cand.display_name, 'assessor_name', v_assessor.display_name,
    'facility', (SELECT name FROM aip_facilities WHERE id = v_cand.facility_id),
    'quiz', v_quiz
  );
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- COMPLETE PROCTORED SESSION: Finalize and record
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_complete_proctored_session(
  p_session_id UUID,
  p_responses JSONB,
  p_proctor_notes TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_session aip_proctored_sessions%ROWTYPE;
  v_results JSONB;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_session FROM aip_proctored_sessions WHERE id = p_session_id;
  IF v_session.id IS NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('error','Session not found'); END IF;
  -- Submit the quiz
  v_results := aip_submit_quiz(v_session.attempt_id, p_responses,
    (SELECT email FROM aip_candidates WHERE id = v_session.candidate_id));
  -- Update session
  UPDATE aip_proctored_sessions SET
    completed_at = now(),
    total_questions = (v_results->>'total_questions')::INTEGER,
    proctor_notes = p_proctor_notes
  WHERE id = p_session_id;
  -- Mark formal assessment as completed
  UPDATE aip_formal_assessments SET status = 'completed' WHERE id = v_session.formal_assessment_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'session_id', p_session_id, 'results', v_results);
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- ADMIN: Create candidate
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_create_candidate(
  p_admin_id UUID,
  p_email TEXT, p_pin TEXT, p_first_name TEXT, p_last_name TEXT,
  p_facility_id UUID, p_overall_belt_id UUID,
  p_knowledge_level_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
  p_script_level_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
  p_practice_level_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
  p_notes TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE v_id UUID;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO aip_candidates (email, pin, first_name, last_name, facility_id,
    overall_belt_id, knowledge_level_id, script_level_id, practice_level_id,
    assigned_by, notes)
  VALUES (lower(p_email), p_pin, p_first_name, p_last_name, p_facility_id,
    p_overall_belt_id,
    COALESCE(p_knowledge_level_id, p_overall_belt_id),
    COALESCE(p_script_level_id, p_overall_belt_id),
    COALESCE(p_practice_level_id, p_overall_belt_id),
    p_admin_id, p_notes)
  RETURNING id INTO v_id;
  -- Log initial level assignment
  INSERT INTO aip_candidate_level_history (candidate_id, dimension, to_level_id, reason, changed_by)
  VALUES (v_id, 'overall_belt', p_overall_belt_id, 'placement', p_admin_id);
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'candidate_id', v_id);
END;
$$;

-- ============================================
-- ADMIN: Set/update candidate level
-- ============================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_set_candidate_level(
  p_admin_id UUID,
  p_candidate_id UUID,
  p_dimension TEXT,        -- 'knowledge', 'script', 'practice', 'overall_belt'
  p_new_level_id UUID,
  p_reason TEXT DEFAULT 'admin_override'
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE v_old UUID; v_col TEXT;
BEGIN
  v_col := p_dimension || '_level_id';
  IF p_dimension = 'overall_belt' THEN v_col := 'overall_belt_id'; END IF;
  -- Get current level
  EXECUTE 'SELECT ' || v_col || ' FROM aip_candidates WHERE id = $1' INTO v_old USING p_candidate_id;
  -- Update
  EXECUTE 'UPDATE aip_candidates SET ' || v_col || ' = $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2' USING p_new_level_id, p_candidate_id;
  -- Log history
  INSERT INTO aip_candidate_level_history (candidate_id, dimension, from_level_id, to_level_id, reason, changed_by)
  VALUES (p_candidate_id, p_dimension, v_old, p_new_level_id, p_reason, p_admin_id);
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true);
END;
$$;

-- RPC: Admin add a single question with answer
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aip_admin_add_question(
  p_level_id UUID,
  p_question_text TEXT,
  p_question_type TEXT DEFAULT 'short_answer',
  p_content_category TEXT DEFAULT 'general',
  p_difficulty TEXT DEFAULT 'medium',
  p_part TEXT DEFAULT 'knowledge',
  p_expected_response TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_fail_indicator TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  p_source TEXT DEFAULT 'manual_entry'
) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
DECLARE v_qid UUID;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO aip_questions (level_id, question_text, question_type, content_category, difficulty, part, source_document, is_active, is_approved)
  VALUES (p_level_id, p_question_text, p_question_type::aip_question_type, p_content_category::aip_content_category, p_difficulty::aip_difficulty, p_part::aip_question_part, p_source, true, true)
  RETURNING id INTO v_qid;

  IF p_expected_response IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO aip_answers (question_id, answer_text, answer_component, sort_order)
    VALUES (v_qid, p_expected_response, 'expected_response', 1);
  END IF;

  IF p_fail_indicator IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO aip_answers (question_id, answer_text, answer_component, sort_order)
    VALUES (v_qid, p_fail_indicator, 'fail_indicator', 2);
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'question_id', v_qid, 'message', 'Question added to library');
END; $$;

-- Create the Master Admin DAVID Intelligence access control table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS david_facility_access (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    facility_id VARCHAR NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
    tier VARCHAR DEFAULT 'base' CHECK (tier IN ('base', 'premium', 'supreme')),
    max_monthly_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 500000,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Create the usage logging table for cost tracking
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS david_usage_logs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    facility_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    user_id UUID NOT NULL,
    prompt_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    completion_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    cost DECIMAL(10, 6) DEFAULT 0.0,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Enable Row Level Security
ALTER TABLE david_facility_access ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE david_usage_logs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Master Admin full access policy (Assuming master_admin role in JWT or specific lookup)
CREATE POLICY "Master Admins can manage facility access" 
ON david_facility_access 
FOR ALL 
USING (auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'master_admin');

-- Facility Admins can only view their own facility access status
CREATE POLICY "Facility Admins can view own access" 
ON david_facility_access 
FOR SELECT 
USING (
    -- Simplistic check; assumes the edge function validates facility assignment
    true 
);

-- Usage logs: Master Admins can see all
CREATE POLICY "Master Admins can view all usage logs" 
ON david_usage_logs 
FOR SELECT 
USING (auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'master_admin');

-- Usage logs: Insert policy (Edge Functions bypass RLS, so this is just a safeguard)
CREATE POLICY "Users can insert own usage logs" 
ON david_usage_logs 
FOR INSERT 
WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Create aggregated view for the Master Dashboard Analytics
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW david_analytics_summary AS
SELECT 
    facility_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_requests,
    SUM(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) as total_tokens,
    SUM(cost) as total_cost,
    MAX(created_at) as last_request_date
FROM david_usage_logs
GROUP BY facility_id;

-- ============================================================
-- ASSESSMENT PIN AUTHORIZATION SYSTEM
-- One-time ephemeral PINs for assessor-gated belt assessments
-- ============================================================

-- 1. Ephemeral PIN storage
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sbd_assessment_pins (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  assessor_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sbd_portal_users(id),
  staff_id UUID NOT NULL,
  facility_id UUID NOT NULL,
  assessment_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'placement',
  pin_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  used BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  used_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  session_id UUID,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Index for fast lookup during validation
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assessment_pins_lookup
  ON sbd_assessment_pins (staff_id, assessment_type, used, expires_at);

-- 2. Assessment sessions (90-min authorization windows)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sbd_assessment_sessions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  staff_id UUID NOT NULL,
  assessor_id UUID NOT NULL,
  facility_id UUID NOT NULL,
  pin_id UUID REFERENCES sbd_assessment_pins(id),
  session_token UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  assessment_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'placement',
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
    CHECK (status IN ('active', 'completed', 'expired', 'revoked')),
  authorized_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  progress JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  device_info JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
  integrity_flags JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Index for session token lookups
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assessment_sessions_token
  ON sbd_assessment_sessions (session_token);

-- 3. Add session reference to placement_reviews
ALTER TABLE placement_reviews
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS session_id UUID REFERENCES sbd_assessment_sessions(id);

-- 4. RLS policies — all access goes through Edge Functions (service role)
ALTER TABLE sbd_assessment_pins ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE sbd_assessment_sessions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Block direct client access; Edge Functions use service_role key
CREATE POLICY "Service role full access pins" ON sbd_assessment_pins
  FOR ALL USING (auth.role() = 'service_role');

CREATE POLICY "Service role full access sessions" ON sbd_assessment_sessions
  FOR ALL USING (auth.role() = 'service_role');

statements:
-- GREEN additive: observation assessment sessions (Gate 3), item-level evidence permanent
create table public.observations (
  id                 uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  staff_id           uuid not null references public.staff(id) on delete cascade,
  fid                uuid references public.facilities(id),
  target_belt        text not null,
  context            text not null default 'gate' check (context in ('gate','placement')),
  checklist_belt     text,
  checklist_version  int default 1,
  status             text not null default 'draft' check (status in ('draft','submitted')),
  item_scores        jsonb not null default '{}',
  task_steps         jsonb not null default '{}',
  tags               jsonb not null default '[]',
  stop_work          jsonb,
  total_points       int,
  outcome            text check (outcome in ('advance','conditional','do_not_advance') or outcome is null),
  outcome_reasons    jsonb not null default '[]',
  assessor_id        uuid,
  assessor_name      text,
  placement_review_id uuid references public.placement_reviews(id),
  started_at         timestamptz default now(),
  submitted_at       timestamptz,
  created_at         timestamptz default now()
);
create index idx_obs_staff_id on public.observations(staff_id);
create index idx_obs_fid      on public.observations(fid);
create index idx_obs_status   on public.observations(status);
create index idx_obs_context  on public.observations(context);

name: add_scale4_to_mr_checklists
statements:
-- YELLOW: adds the four-level capture scale to the stored M/R instruments.
-- Decision rules untouched. 3 or 2 derives to PASS, 1 or 0 derives to FAIL.
-- Brown presentation criteria and Black component dimensions stay binary as written.
update public.observation_checklists
set schema = jsonb_set(
  jsonb_set(schema, '{scale}', '[
    {"v":3,"label":"Consistent & Independent","desc":"Demonstrated consistently and independently across all observed instances. No prompting required."},
    {"v":2,"label":"One Non-Recurring Deviation","desc":"Demonstrated in most instances with one observed deviation that did not recur. No safety impact."},
    {"v":1,"label":"Inconsistent","desc":"Demonstrated inconsistently. Multiple deviations observed. Development continues before reassessment."},
    {"v":0,"label":"Not Demonstrated / Violation","desc":"Not demonstrated or active violation observed. Remediate and reassess."}
  ]'::jsonb),
  '{derivedPass}', '"Numeric capture: 2 or higher counts as PASS, 1 or lower counts as FAIL for all Mandatory and Recommended rules."'::jsonb)
where belt in ('Yellow','Green','Blue','Brown') and version = 1;

name: transfer_requests
statements:
-- Module 3 / STAFF-F6: persist the dual-admin transfer verification queue.
-- Previously DB.pendingTransfers lived only in client memory, so a second admin
-- in another session could never see or approve a request, and the backend
-- release executed at request time (single-admin). This table makes the queue
-- durable and shared; execution is deferred until a second admin approves.
--
-- Run this in the Supabase SQL editor BEFORE (or together with) deploying the
-- frontend from branch fix/module-3-staff-management.

create table public.transfer_requests (
  id                uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  type              text not null check (type in ('release','assignment')),
  staff_id          uuid,            -- release: the staff row being released
  fa_id             uuid,            -- assignment: the free_agents row being placed
  staff_name        text,
  belt              text,
  from_fac_id       uuid,
  from_fac_name     text,
  to_fac_id         uuid,
  to_fac_name       text,
  to_fac_loc        text,
  reason            text,
  notes             text,
  effect_date       date,
  status            text not null default 'pending' check (status in ('pending','approved','denied')),
  requested_by      text not null,   -- portal user id of the initiating admin (self-approval guard)
  requested_by_name text,
  requested_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
  decided_by        text,            -- approving/denying admin (must differ from requested_by)
  decided_by_name   text,
  decided_at        timestamptz,
  deny_reason       text,
  created_at        timestamptz not null default now()
)
create index transfer_requests_status_idx on public.transfer_requests (status)
create index transfer_requests_staff_idx  on public.transfer_requests (staff_id)
alter table public.transfer_requests enable row level security

-- Admin check mirroring the role-resolution order used by the sbd-* edge functions:
-- JWT app/user metadata role -> sbd_portal_users by auth uid -> by email -> known
-- SIPS master-admin emails. NOTE: a bare auth.jwt()->>'role' is NOT reliable here —
-- in a stock Supabase JWT it is the Postgres role ('authenticated'), and master
-- admins may not exist in sbd_portal_users at all (they are hardcoded in the
-- frontend), which is exactly why sbd-release-to-free-agent has the same fallbacks.
create or replace function public.sbd_is_admin() returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select
    coalesce(auth.jwt()->'app_metadata'->>'role',
             auth.jwt()->'user_metadata'->>'role',
             auth.jwt()->>'role')
      in ('master_admin','staff_admin','admin')
    or exists (
      select 1 from public.sbd_portal_users u
      where (u.id = auth.uid() or lower(u.email) = lower(coalesce(auth.jwt()->>'email','')))
        and u.role in ('master_admin','staff_admin','admin')
    )
    or lower(coalesce(auth.jwt()->>'email','')) in
       ('jjacobs@sipsconsults.com','izambrano@sipsconsults.com','dpayne@sipsconsults.com');
$$

create policy "transfer_requests_admin_all" on public.transfer_requests for all
  to authenticated
  using (public.sbd_is_admin())
  with check (public.sbd_is_admin())

name: cleanup_orphaned_assigned_fids
statements:
-- Module 7 QA — ADM-F1 data cleanup
-- Strips orphaned facility refs (pointing at deleted/non-existent facilities) from
-- sbd_portal_users.assigned_facility_ids. The UI now renders "Unknown facility" for
-- any remaining orphans, so applying this is cleanup, not a blocker.
--
-- Review before applying: run the SELECT below first to see which rows are affected.
--
--   SELECT id, email, assigned_facility_ids
--   FROM sbd_portal_users u
--   WHERE EXISTS (
--     SELECT 1 FROM unnest(u.assigned_facility_ids) AS fid
--     WHERE fid::text NOT IN (SELECT id::text FROM facilities)
--   );

UPDATE sbd_portal_users u
SET assigned_facility_ids = (
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(fid), '{}')
  FROM unnest(u.assigned_facility_ids) AS fid
  WHERE fid::text IN (SELECT id::text FROM facilities)
)
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM unnest(u.assigned_facility_ids) AS fid
  WHERE fid::text NOT IN (SELECT id::text FROM facilities)
)

name: belt_tests
statements:
-- ============================================================================
-- Dynamic Belt Test (Track A4) — schema
--   sbd_belt_tests          generated, per-learner test (questions + seed)
--   sbd_belt_test_results   persisted AssessmentResult (spec §12, never recomputed)
-- RLS mirrors sbd_assessment_queue / placement_reviews:
--   master_admin: all · staff_admin: assigned_facility_ids · facility_admin/
--   hospital: own facility · staff_member: own staff_id.
-- Test rows are WRITTEN by the service-role edge fn only (no client INSERT).
-- ============================================================================

-- ── Generated tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sbd_belt_tests (
    id             uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    staff_id       uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.staff(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    facility_id    uuid REFERENCES public.facilities(id),
    queue_ids      jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,        -- approved Competency+Simulation queue rows this test satisfies
    target_belt    text NOT NULL CHECK (target_belt IN ('White','Yellow','Green','Blue','Brown','Black')),
    seed           bigint NOT NULL,                  -- deriveSeed(staff,belt,date) — regeneration is deterministic
    test_date      date NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
    questions      jsonb NOT NULL,                   -- { knowledge:[..], simulation:[..] } incl correct/rubric/skeleton_slot/variant_status
    variant_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fallback' CHECK (variant_status IN ('ai','fallback','mixed')),
    status         text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','submitted','expired','void')),
    created_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    submitted_at   timestamptz
)

-- One ACTIVE test per (staff, belt) — makes generation idempotent ("reload returns the same test").
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sbd_belt_tests_active_uq
    ON public.sbd_belt_tests (staff_id, target_belt)
    WHERE status = 'active'
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sbd_belt_tests_staff_idx ON public.sbd_belt_tests (staff_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sbd_belt_tests_fac_idx   ON public.sbd_belt_tests (facility_id)
ALTER TABLE public.sbd_belt_tests ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "bt_master_all" ON public.sbd_belt_tests
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "bt_staff_admin_select" ON public.sbd_belt_tests
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "bt_facility_select" ON public.sbd_belt_tests
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "bt_member_self_select" ON public.sbd_belt_tests

CREATE POLICY "bt_master_all" ON public.sbd_belt_tests FOR ALL TO authenticated
    USING (auth.jwt()->>'role' = 'master_admin')
    WITH CHECK (auth.jwt()->>'role' = 'master_admin')

CREATE POLICY "bt_staff_admin_select" ON public.sbd_belt_tests FOR SELECT TO authenticated
    USING (auth.jwt()->>'role' = 'staff_admin'
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.sbd_portal_users u WHERE u.auth_uid = auth.uid() AND facility_id::text = ANY(u.assigned_facility_ids)))

CREATE POLICY "bt_facility_select" ON public.sbd_belt_tests FOR SELECT TO authenticated
    USING (facility_id = (auth.jwt()->>'facility_id')::uuid)

CREATE POLICY "bt_member_self_select" ON public.sbd_belt_tests FOR SELECT TO authenticated
    USING (staff_id = (auth.jwt()->>'staff_id')::uuid)

-- NOTE: no client INSERT/UPDATE policy — the generation edge function uses the
-- service role and bypasses RLS. Candidates can read their own test, not write it.

-- ── Persisted results (spec §12) ────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sbd_belt_test_results (
    id                      uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    test_id                 uuid REFERENCES public.sbd_belt_tests(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    staff_id                uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.staff(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    facility_id             uuid REFERENCES public.facilities(id),
    target_belt             text NOT NULL,
    submitted_at            timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    scored_at               timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    -- Knowledge
    k_level_scores          jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,   -- { L1..L5 }
    k_overall               numeric,
    k_floor_results         jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    k_overall_passed        boolean,
    -- Simulation
    sim_responses           jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,   -- [{ question_id, level, score }]
    sim_level_avgs          jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    sim_overall             numeric,
    sim_floor_results       jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    sim_individual_min      numeric,
    sim_overall_passed      boolean,
    -- Blended
    blended_score           numeric,
    blended_passed          boolean,
    -- Suggestion
    system_suggestion       text,
    outcome                 text CHECK (outcome IN ('PASS','CONDITIONAL_PASS','REMEDIATION')),
    suggestion_reason_codes jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    conditions              jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    watch_flags             jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    remediation_flags       jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- Final / override (present-but-unused at v1; assessor surface populates later)
    final_belt              text,
    override_applied        boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    override_by             uuid,
    override_justification  text,
    override_at             timestamptz,
    status                  text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_REVIEW'
                              CHECK (status IN ('PENDING_REVIEW','ACCEPTED','OVERRIDDEN','REMEDIATION_REQUIRED')),
    created_at              timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sbd_btr_staff_idx  ON public.sbd_belt_test_results (staff_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sbd_btr_fac_idx    ON public.sbd_belt_test_results (facility_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sbd_btr_status_idx ON public.sbd_belt_test_results (status)
ALTER TABLE public.sbd_belt_test_results ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "btr_master_all" ON public.sbd_belt_test_results
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "btr_staff_admin_all" ON public.sbd_belt_test_results
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "btr_facility_all" ON public.sbd_belt_test_results
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "btr_hospital_select" ON public.sbd_belt_test_results
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "btr_member_self_insert" ON public.sbd_belt_test_results
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "btr_member_self_select" ON public.sbd_belt_test_results

CREATE POLICY "btr_master_all" ON public.sbd_belt_test_results FOR ALL TO authenticated
    USING (auth.jwt()->>'role' = 'master_admin')
    WITH CHECK (auth.jwt()->>'role' = 'master_admin')

CREATE POLICY "btr_staff_admin_all" ON public.sbd_belt_test_results FOR ALL TO authenticated
    USING (auth.jwt()->>'role' = 'staff_admin'
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.sbd_portal_users u WHERE u.auth_uid = auth.uid() AND facility_id::text = ANY(u.assigned_facility_ids)))
    WITH CHECK (auth.jwt()->>'role' = 'staff_admin'
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.sbd_portal_users u WHERE u.auth_uid = auth.uid() AND facility_id::text = ANY(u.assigned_facility_ids)))

CREATE POLICY "btr_facility_all" ON public.sbd_belt_test_results FOR ALL TO authenticated
    USING (auth.jwt()->>'role' = 'facility_admin' AND facility_id = (auth.jwt()->>'facility_id')::uuid)
    WITH CHECK (auth.jwt()->>'role' = 'facility_admin' AND facility_id = (auth.jwt()->>'facility_id')::uuid)

CREATE POLICY "btr_hospital_select" ON public.sbd_belt_test_results FOR SELECT TO authenticated
    USING (facility_id = (auth.jwt()->>'facility_id')::uuid)

-- Candidate may submit (INSERT) and read their own result; they may NOT update it
-- (acceptance/override is an assessor action — spec §11).
CREATE POLICY "btr_member_self_insert" ON public.sbd_belt_test_results FOR INSERT TO authenticated
    WITH CHECK (staff_id = (auth.jwt()->>'staff_id')::uuid)

CREATE POLICY "btr_member_self_select" ON public.sbd_belt_test_results FOR SELECT TO authenticated
    USING (staff_id = (auth.jwt()->>'staff_id')::uuid)

-- Close the generated active test when the candidate submits a persisted result.
-- This preserves the "one active test" invariant without granting client UPDATE
-- access on the stored question row.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sbd_mark_belt_test_submitted()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.test_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        UPDATE public.sbd_belt_tests
        SET status = 'submitted',
            submitted_at = COALESCE(NEW.submitted_at, now())
        WHERE id = NEW.test_id
          AND staff_id = NEW.staff_id
          AND status = 'active';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS sbd_btr_mark_test_submitted ON public.sbd_belt_test_results

CREATE TRIGGER sbd_btr_mark_test_submitted
AFTER INSERT ON public.sbd_belt_test_results
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION public.sbd_mark_belt_test_submitted()

-- ── Question bank store (single row, JSONB) ─────────────────────────────────
-- Holds the authored bank incl. correct answers + critical tags. RLS is enabled
-- with NO policies, so no client can read it; the generation edge fn reads it
-- with the service role (bypasses RLS). Keeps the answer key private. Load the
-- data with: INSERT INTO public.sbd_belt_bank (id, data) VALUES (1, $bank$...$bank$::jsonb)
--            ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET data = EXCLUDED.data, updated_at = now();
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.sbd_belt_bank (
    id         integer PRIMARY KEY,
    data       jsonb NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
ALTER TABLE public.sbd_belt_bank ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

name: david_user_access_and_memory
statements:
-- 20260617120000_david_user_access_and_memory.sql
-- PRE-2 (DAVID phased build plan §3): heal the "missing-but-referenced" DAVID per-user tables.
-- These three tables are read/written by live code but had NO migration, so they only exist
-- where someone created them by hand. Without them: non-master DAVID access fails (auth.ts:35),
-- the admin user-toggle dashboard 500s (david-admin-api), and meta-memory/swarm memory silently
-- no-op. All statements are idempotent so this is safe to apply over hand-created tables.
--
-- IDENTIFIER SPACES (verified against code — do not "simplify"):
--   * david_user_access.user_id   = sbd_portal_users.id  (UUID)   — auth.ts:37, david-admin-api:237
--   * david_user_access.facility_id = VARCHAR string       — matches david_facility_access (NOT facilities.id uuid)
--   * david_user_preferences.user_id = auth.users.id (auth uid)    — index.ts:69, DavidChat.js:1751/1771
--   * assistant_memory.user_id       = auth.users.id (auth uid)    — index.ts:54/264
-- Edge functions use the service role (RLS-bypassing); the policies below exist so the FRONTEND
-- (which queries as the authenticated user) can read/write only its own rows.

-- ============================================================================
-- 1. david_user_access — per-user DAVID toggle within a facility
--    Granular gate layered on top of david_facility_access (auth.ts requires BOTH active).
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.david_user_access (
    id          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    user_id     UUID NOT NULL,            -- sbd_portal_users.id
    facility_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,         -- string form, matches david_facility_access.facility_id
    is_active   BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
    granted_by  UUID,                     -- sbd_portal_users.id of the master admin who granted it
    granted_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
)

-- One access row per (user, facility) — the code upserts on this pair (.eq user_id .eq facility_id).
-- Created as an index so it also heals a hand-made table that lacked the constraint.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS david_user_access_user_facility_uniq
    ON public.david_user_access (user_id, facility_id)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS david_user_access_facility_idx
    ON public.david_user_access (facility_id)
ALTER TABLE public.david_user_access ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
GRANT ALL ON public.david_user_access TO service_role

-- Master admins manage all rows (admin dashboard).
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "dua_master_all" ON public.david_user_access

CREATE POLICY "dua_master_all" ON public.david_user_access FOR ALL
    TO authenticated
    USING (auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'master_admin')
    WITH CHECK (auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'master_admin')

-- A user may read ONLY their own access row (so the frontend nav gate getDavidAccess works).
-- user_id is a sbd_portal_users.id, so map it back to the caller via auth_uid = auth.uid().
-- (Relies on sbd_portal_users allowing the caller to self-read, which it already does:
--  api-supabase.js getUserProfile reads sbd_portal_users by auth_uid as the user in prod.)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "dua_self_select" ON public.david_user_access

CREATE POLICY "dua_self_select" ON public.david_user_access FOR SELECT
    TO authenticated
    USING (user_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.sbd_portal_users WHERE auth_uid = auth.uid()))

-- ============================================================================
-- 2. david_user_preferences — per-user meta-memory blob (one row per user)
--    PK = user_id (auth uid) so the frontend's `Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates`
--    POST (DavidChat.js:1765, no on_conflict param) correctly UPSERTS instead of
--    inserting duplicates — PostgREST resolves merge-duplicates on the primary key.
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.david_user_preferences (
    user_id     UUID PRIMARY KEY,         -- auth.users.id
    memory_blob TEXT,                      -- freeform string; injected verbatim into the prompt
    created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
)
ALTER TABLE public.david_user_preferences ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
GRANT ALL ON public.david_user_preferences TO service_role

-- user_id IS the auth uid here, so self-access is a direct equality (no subquery needed).
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "dup_self_all" ON public.david_user_preferences

CREATE POLICY "dup_self_all" ON public.david_user_preferences FOR ALL
    TO authenticated
    USING (auth.uid() = user_id)
    WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "dup_master_all" ON public.david_user_preferences

CREATE POLICY "dup_master_all" ON public.david_user_preferences FOR ALL
    TO authenticated
    USING (auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'master_admin')
    WITH CHECK (auth.jwt() ->> 'role' = 'master_admin')

-- ============================================================================
-- 3. assistant_memory — append-only swarm memory of DAVID interactions
--    Written/read only by the edge function (service role); no frontend access.
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.assistant_memory (
    id               UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    user_id          UUID NOT NULL,        -- auth.users.id (profile.auth_uid on insert)
    interaction_type TEXT,
    context_summary  TEXT,
    raw_interaction  JSONB,                -- { query, response }
    created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS assistant_memory_user_created_idx
    ON public.assistant_memory (user_id, created_at DESC)
ALTER TABLE public.assistant_memory ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
GRANT ALL ON public.assistant_memory TO service_role

-- A user may read their own memories; master admins may read all. Inserts come from the
-- service-role edge function (RLS-bypassing), so no INSERT policy is required for users.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "am_self_select" ON public.assistant_memory

CREATE POLICY "am_self_select" ON public.assistant_memory FOR SELECT
    TO authenticated
